emperors.summary: 结束列国分立、建立中央集权帝制的秦帝国开创者。
emperors.summary_en: Founder of the Qin empire, who ended the division of the Warring States and established a centralized imperial system.

names.display_en: Qin Er Shi, the Second Emperor of Qin

emperors.summary: 秦始皇之后短促在位的二世皇帝，秦政崩解的关键人物。
emperors.summary_en: The Second Emperor of Qin, whose brief reign after Qin Shi Huang made him a key figure in the collapse of Qin rule.

emperors.summary: 赵高弑二世后立，在位四十六日，诛高降汉，旋为项羽所杀；未称帝号，图鉴作准帝。
emperors.summary_en: Installed by Zhao Gao after the murder of the Second Emperor, he reigned forty-six days, slew Gao, surrendered to Han, and was put to death by Xiang Yu; never bearing the imperial title, the gazetteer lists him as quasi-emperor.

emperors.summary: 由布衣起兵、击败西楚、开创汉朝的开国皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: Founding emperor of the Han dynasty, who rose from commoner origins, defeated Western Chu, and founded the Han.

emperors.summary: 高祖太子继位七年，仁弱受制于吕后，长安城成于其朝，开文景休养之基。
emperors.summary_en: The heir of Gaozu reigned seven years, gentle and controlled by Empress Lü; the walls of Chang'an rose in his reign, laying the base for the Wen-Jing recovery.

emperors.summary: 惠帝崩后吕后所立幼帝，在位有名无权，四年被幽杀；吕氏称制的符号皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The child emperor enthroned by Empress Lü after Emperor Hui's death, a symbol of her regency with no real power; he was imprisoned and slain in his fourth year.

emperors.summary: 前少帝废后所立，高后崩后大臣诛诸吕，以其非惠帝子废杀，汉统重归刘氏。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned after the Former Young Emperor was deposed, he was set aside and slain when the ministers destroyed the Lü clan after the empress dowager's death, restoring the Han line to the Liu house.

emperors.summary: 以代王入继大统，除肉刑、免田租、罢露台，恭俭二十三年，开文景之治。
emperors.summary_en: Entering the throne as King of Dai, he abolished mutilation punishments, remitted the land tax, and forwent the Terrace; frugal through twenty-three years, he opened the Wen-Jing recovery.

emperors.summary: 承文帝宽政，平七国之乱，削藩固本；然诛晁错、杀周亚夫，史讥刻薄寡恩。
emperors.summary_en: Continuing Wen's lenient course, he put down the Revolt of the Seven States and trimmed the feudatories to steady the throne; yet the deaths of Chao Cuo and Zhou Yafu drew the censure of cold ingratitude.

emperors.summary: 在位半个多世纪，拓边、改制、尊崇儒术，把汉帝国推向极盛并留下深刻制度遗产的皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: An emperor whose half-century reign expanded the frontiers, remade institutions, and exalted Confucian learning, carrying the Han empire to its zenith and leaving a deep institutional legacy.

emperors.summary: 八岁即位，霍光辅政，盐铁之议、轻徭薄赋，与民休息；年二十一崩而无嗣。
emperors.summary_en: Ascending at eight with Huo Guang as regent, he brought the Salt and Iron Debate, light corvée and taxes, and rest for the people; he died at twenty-one without issue.

emperors.summary: 昭帝崩后继位，在位二十七日以行淫乱被霍光等废归国，宣帝时封海昏侯。
emperors.summary_en: He succeeded after Emperor Zhao's death and was deposed after twenty-seven days for dissolute conduct; returned to his state, he was later enfeoffed as Marquis of Haihun.

emperors.summary: 以皇曾孙之身自民间入继大统，亲政后综核名实、信赏必罚，置西域都护并受呼韩邪单于入朝的西汉中兴之主。
emperors.summary_en: Raised among the people as an imperial great-grandson, he succeeded to the throne, ruled by matching names to reality with sure rewards and punishments, established the Protector General of the Western Regions, and received Chanyu Huhanye at court, restoring Western Han.

emperors.summary: 宣帝太子，柔仁好儒而优游不断；石显弄权、昭君出塞，西汉由盛转衰之节点。
emperors.summary_en: Heir of Emperor Xuan, gentle and fond of Confucian learning yet irresolute; with Shi Xian wielding power and Wang Zhaojun sent to the Xiongnu, his reign marks the hinge of Western Han's decline.

emperors.summary: 元帝太子，湛于酒色，外戚王氏擅朝，立赵飞燕为后，为王莽篡汉铺垫。
emperors.summary_en: Heir of Emperor Yuan, sunk in wine and women; the Wang consorts dominated the court and Zhao Feiyan became empress, paving the way for Wang Mang's usurpation.

emperors.summary: 成帝养子继位，欲强主威而限田夺权皆败，宠董贤，终使王莽乘隙再起。
emperors.summary_en: Adopted by Emperor Cheng, he tried to strengthen the throne with land limits and power grabs, all in vain; his favor for Dong Xian let Wang Mang rise again.

emperors.summary: 九岁入继，政由王莽；莽女为后、莽加九锡，平帝崩年十四，本纪书崩而莽传载鸠说。
emperors.summary_en: Brought in at nine with all policy from Wang Mang; Mang's daughter became empress and Mang took the Nine Distinctions. Ping died at fourteen; the benji records death, Mang's biography speaks of poison.

emperors.summary: 宣帝玄孙，二岁立为皇太子，王莽居摄践祚，三年后禅位废为定安公，更始时死于乱兵。
emperors.summary_en: A great-great-grandson of Emperor Xuan, made heir at two; Wang Mang ruled as regent, took the throne by abdication, and demoted him to Duke of Ding'an; he died amid the disorder of the Gengshi era.

emperors.summary: 以外戚身份与儒学声望居摄代汉，建国号新并力行托古改制，终在边患与民变中迅速崩亡的争议之主。
emperors.summary_en: A consort-clan kinsman whose Confucian renown carried him from regency to the throne, he founded the Xin dynasty and pressed archaizing reforms, a controversial ruler whose regime swiftly collapsed amid frontier wars and popular revolt.

emperors.summary: 新末起兵、昆阳破新，重建汉室而定都洛阳，以柔道治国、封禅告成的中兴开国皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: Restorer of the Han who rose amid the Xin-dynasty collapse, shattered the Xin army at Kunyang, refounded the dynasty with its capital at Luoyang, governed by the "way of softness," and crowned the restoration with the Feng and Shan sacrifices.

emperors.summary: 光武之子，严切持法，后宫不封侯与政；永平求法、云台图画，窦固取伊吾，班超使西域，明章之治前半。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Guangwu, strict in law and keeping the harem from power; the Yongping search for the Dharma, the Yuntai portraits, Dou Gu taking Yiwu, and Ban Chao sent west — the first half of the Ming-Zhang age.

emperors.summary: 明帝子，崇儒白虎观，宽厚安民，班超定西域；宠任窦氏，外戚之祸伏焉。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Emperor Ming, he exalted Confucianism at White Tiger Hall and ruled with breadth and lenience while Ban Chao settled the Western Regions; his indulgence of the Dou clan planted the consort-clan disaster.

emperors.summary: 十岁即位，窦太后临朝；永元元年窦宪破北匈奴勒石燕然，四年和帝诛窦宪亲政，然宦官始盛。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at ten under the Dou regency; in Yongyuan 1 Dou Xian broke the northern Xiongnu and carved the Yanran inscription; in Yongyuan 4 He destroyed Dou Xian and ruled in person, yet the eunuchs began their rise.

emperors.summary: 和帝少子，即位时出生百余日，延平元年八月崩，东汉最短祚皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The youngest son of Emperor He, enthroned at barely a hundred days old; he died in the eighth month of Yanping 1, the briefest reign in Eastern Han.

emperors.summary: 清河王子，十三岁入继；永初羌乱耗竭国用，亲政后诛邓氏而乳母宦官用事，南巡崩于叶。
emperors.summary_en: A son of the prince of Qinghe, brought in at thirteen; the Yongchu Qiang wars drained the treasury, and after taking power he destroyed the Dengs only to see his wet nurses and eunuchs rule; he died at Ye during a southern tour.

emperors.summary: 安帝崩后阎后所立，在位约二百日即薨，宦官孙程等十九人迎立顺帝。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned by Empress Yan after Emperor An's death, he died after some two hundred days; the eunuch Sun Cheng and nineteen others then enthroned Emperor Shun.

emperors.summary: 安帝太子被废为济阴王，宦官孙程等迎立；梁氏外戚自此擅权，班勇复通西域。
emperors.summary_en: Heir of Emperor An, deposed to be prince of Jiyin and restored by the eunuch Sun Cheng; the Liang consort clan dominated thereafter, while Ban Yong reopened the Western Regions.

emperors.summary: 顺帝子，二岁即位，梁太后临朝；次年崩，梁冀立质帝。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Emperor Shun, enthroned at two under the Liang regency; he died the next year and Liang Ji raised Emperor Zhi.

emperors.summary: 冲帝崩后梁冀所立，年八岁；聪慧目梁冀为「跋扈将军」，本初元年被鸩杀，梁冀立桓帝。
emperors.summary_en: Raised by Liang Ji after Emperor Chong's death, he was eight; his sharp tongue called Liang Ji the "arrogant general," and in the first Benchu year he was poisoned, Liang Ji enthroning Emperor Huan.

emperors.summary: 梁冀所立，十五岁即位；延熹二年与宦官诛梁冀，宦官五侯擅政，党锢之祸起于此朝。
emperors.summary_en: Raised by Liang Ji, enthroned at fifteen; in Yanxi 2 he destroyed Liang Ji with the eunuchs, the Five Marquises dominated, and the proscription of partisans began in his reign.

emperors.summary: 窦武迎立，十二岁即位；窦武陈蕃谋诛宦官败，党锢复炽，西园卖官，黄巾起，东汉之乱自此而始。
emperors.summary_en: Raised by Dou Wu, enthroned at twelve; Dou Wu and Chen Fan's plot against the eunuchs failed, the proscription flared again, offices were sold at the West Garden, and the Yellow Turbans rose — the great disorder of Eastern Han began here.

emperors.summary: 灵帝子，何后所生；何进谋诛宦官事泄被杀，董卓入京废辩为弘农王，次年被鸩杀。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Emperor Ling by Empress He; He Jin's plot against the eunuchs leaked and cost him his life, Dong Zhuo entered the capital and demoted Bian to Prince of Hongnong, who was poisoned the next year.

emperors.summary: 董卓废辩而立，九岁即位；迁都长安、东归洛阳、都许，禅位于曹丕，汉亡；逊位为山阳公十四年。
emperors.summary_en: Raised by Dong Zhuo in place of Bian, enthroned at nine; he moved to Chang'an, wandered east, settled at Xu, and abdicated to Cao Pi, ending the Han; he lived fourteen years as Duke of Shanyang.

emperors.summary: 受禅代汉，建魏都洛阳，定九品官人法之端，性好文学，作《典论》，史称天资文藻。
emperors.summary_en: Receiving the abdication of Han, he founded Wei at Luoyang, began the nine-rank method of appointing officials, and, loving letters, wrote the *Dianlun*; the histories call him gifted of literary talent.

emperors.summary: 在位十三年，拒诸葛亮北伐、平辽东公孙渊，然大兴宫室，托孤曹爽司马懿，开高平陵之变伏线。
emperors.summary_en: In thirteen years he repelled Zhuge Liang's northern expeditions and subdued Gongsun Yuan in Liaodong, yet built palaces on a grand scale and entrusted his heir to Cao Shuang and Sima Yi, laying the fuse of the Gaopingling incident.

emperors.summary: 明帝养子即位，年甫八岁，权归曹爽司马懿；高平陵变后司马氏专权，嘉平六年被废为齐王。
emperors.summary_en: Adopted heir of Emperor Ming, he came to the throne at eight, power resting with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi; after the Gaopingling incident Sima's house ruled alone, and in the 6th year of Jiaping he was deposed as Prince of Qi.

emperors.summary: 齐王芳废后迎立，好学明经，志在剪除司马氏；甘露五年率宿卫讨司马昭，于南阙下被弑，时年二十。
emperors.summary_en: Called to the throne after Cao Fang's deposition, he was a scholar-emperor set on rooting out the Simas; in the 5th year of Ganlu he led his guards against Sima Zhao and was slain beneath the southern gate, aged twenty.

emperors.summary: 高贵乡公被弑后迎立，在位五年，政由司马昭；景元四年灭蜀，咸熙二年禅位于晋，曹魏亡。
emperors.summary_en: Installed after the duke of Gaogui District was slain, he reigned five years while Sima Zhao ruled; in the 4th year of Jingyuan Shu was destroyed, and in the 2nd of Xianxi he abdicated to Jin, ending Wei.

emperors.summary: 少孤贩履，以兴复汉室为志，得诸葛亮而后成三分之业；章武元年称帝，为报关羽之仇伐吴，夷陵大败，崩于永安。
emperors.summary_en: Orphaned young, he hawked straw shoes; with the restoration of Han as his aim, he won the tripartite realm after gaining Zhuge Liang; crowned in the 1st year of Zhangwu, he attacked Wu to avenge Guan Yu, was shattered at Yiling, and died at Yong'an.
tags_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Hut

emperors.summary: 先主崩后继位，任诸葛亮而蜀汉得治；亮卒后信黄皓、北伐无成，景耀六年邓艾入蜀，衔璧出降，封安乐公，「乐不思蜀」留笑史。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding the First Sovereign, he governed well while trusting Zhuge Liang; after Liang's death he heeded Huang Hao and the northern wars failed, until Deng Ai entered Shu in the 6th year of Jingyao and he surrendered with the seal in his mouth, enfeoffed Duke of Anle — his "happier here than in Shu" staying a byword.

emperors.summary: 继兄业据江东，赤壁破曹、袭取荆州、夷陵败备，黄龙元年称帝建业，为吴国开基之主；晚年二宫之争，立嗣两误。
emperors.summary_en: He took up his brother's enterprise in Jiangdong, broke Cao at the Red Cliffs, seized Jingzhou, defeated Bei at Yiling, and in the 1st year of Huanglong took the throne at Jianye as founder of Wu; in old age the two-palace feud wrecked the succession.

emperors.summary: 孙权少子，九岁即位，权臣迭兴；太平三年谋诛孙綝不密，被废为会稽王，居会稽，后自杀，年十八。
emperors.summary_en: Youngest son of Sun Quan, he came to the throne at nine as power passed from one strong minister to the next; in the 3rd year of Taiping his plot against Sun Chen leaked, he was deposed as Prince of Kuajji, and later put to death himself at eighteen.

emperors.summary: 孙亮废后迎立，与张布、丁奉设谋诛孙綝，亲政后立学校、置博士；永安六年崩，年三十。
emperors.summary_en: Installed after Sun Liang's deposition, he and Zhang Bu and Ding Feng laid the plot that slew Sun Chen; governing himself, he founded schools and chairs of learning, and died in the 6th year of Yong'an, aged thirty.

emperors.summary: 孙休崩后迎立，初有善政，旋以暴虐著称：杀张尚、任何定、改元无度；天纪四年晋六路伐吴，面缚出降，吴亡，封归命侯。
emperors.summary_en: Installed after Sun Xiu's death, he governed well at first, then grew notorious for cruelty: slaying Zhang Shang, favoring He Ding, changing eras without count; in the 4th year of Tianji, with Jin invading on six roads, he surrendered bound and bare, ending Wu, and was enfeoffed Marquis of Guiming.

emperors.summary: 受禅代魏建晋，太康元年平吴一统天下，罢州郡兵、大封宗室；晚年荒淫纵欲、宠信后党，为八王之乱埋祸。
emperors.summary_en: He received Wei's abdication to found Jin, unified the realm by conquering Wu in the 1st year of Taikang, disbanded the provincial armies, and enfeoffed the princes widely; in later years he gave himself to pleasure and trusted his wives' kin, laying the fuse of the War of the Eight Princes.

emperors.summary: 武帝子，性愚钝，在位十六年而八王之乱起，天下大乱；「何不食肉糜」为史所讥，光熙元年还洛后崩，或云被毒杀。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Emperor Wu, dull-witted, he sat sixteen years while the War of the Eight Princes tore the realm apart; his "why not eat minced meat?" became a byword for his folly, and in the 1st year of Guangxi he died after returning to Luoyang — by poison, some say.

emperors.summary: 惠帝崩后继位，好学博综，然东海王越专权；永嘉五年刘曜破洛阳，帝蒙尘，后于平阳被杀，西晋元气尽丧。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding Emperor Hui, he was a student of wide learning, but the Prince of Donghai ruled; in the 5th year of Yongjia Liu Yao broke Luoyang, the emperor was carried off, and he was put to death at Pingyang — the strength of Western Jin was spent.

emperors.summary: 怀帝遇害后继立于长安，关中残破食尽；建兴四年刘曜破长安，帝舆榇出降，西晋亡，后于平阳被杀。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding after Emperor Huai's murder, he took the throne at Chang'an in a broken, starving Guanzhong; in the 4th year of Jianxing Liu Yao took the city, the emperor surrendered with the coffin in his cart, Western Jin perished, and he was slain at Pingyang.

emperors.summary: 八王之乱中出镇建邺，用王导计经营江东，愍帝遇害后称帝建康，开东晋一朝「王与马共天下」之局；王敦举兵犯阙，忧愤而崩。
emperors.summary_en: Sent to Jianye during the War of the Eight Princes, he built up Jiangdong on Wang Dao's counsel, and after Emperor Min's death took the throne at Jiankang, opening Eastern Jin's "Wang and Sima sharing the realm"; when Wang Dun marched on the capital he died of grief and rage.
tags_en: Wang and Sima Sharing the Realm

emperors.summary: 元帝长子，性至孝、有文武才略；太宁二年亲征讨平王敦之乱，江东复安，寻崩，年二十七。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Yuan, devoted to his parents and gifted in arms and letters; in the 2nd year of Taining he campaigned in person against Wang Dun and restored peace to Jiangdong, then died at twenty-seven.

emperors.summary: 五岁即位，庾后临朝、庾亮执政；咸和年间苏峻之乱，台城倾覆、帝蒙尘，赖陶侃等平乱复辟；后委政大臣，在位十七年。
emperors.summary_en: Ascending at five, he sat under Empress Yu's regency and Yu Liang's government; in the Xianhe years the Su Jun revolt saw the palace taken and the emperor carried off, until Tao Kan and the others put it down; thereafter he left rule to his ministers, reigning seventeen years.

emperors.summary: 成帝崩后兄终弟及，在位二年；庾翼经营襄阳欲北伐，未竟而崩，国事仍归门阀。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding his brother Emperor Cheng, he reigned two years; Yu Yi's plans for a northern expedition from Xiangyang were unfinished when he died, and the government stayed in the great clans' hands.

emperors.summary: 两岁即位，褚太后临朝；永和年间桓温灭成汉、北伐关中复洛阳，殷浩、谢万北伐皆败；升平五年崩，年十九。
emperors.summary_en: Ascending at two under Empress Chu's regency, his Yonghe years saw Huan Wen destroy Cheng Han, march into Guanzhong, and restore Luoyang, while Yin Hao's and Xie Wan's expeditions failed; he died in the 5th year of Shengping at nineteen.

emperors.summary: 穆帝崩后即位，好黄老、断谷饵药；桓温请迁都洛阳，朝议未果；兴宁三年因服长生药中毒而崩，年二十五。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding Emperor Mu, he delighted in Huang–Lao, abstained from grain, and took elixirs; Huan Wen's plea to move the capital to Luoyang came to nothing; in the 3rd year of Xingning he died of poison from his longevity drugs, aged twenty-five.

emperors.summary: 哀帝崩后即位，桓温枋头之败后欲立威，诬帝不能男，废为东海王，后降海西公；太元十一年薨于吴。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding Emperor Ai, he was deposed after Huan Wen's defeat at Fangtou — Wen, seeking to awe the court, falsely charged the emperor with impotence, degraded him to Prince of Donghai and then Duke of Haixi; he died in Wu in the 11th year of Taiyuan.

emperors.summary: 元帝少子，长期辅政，清虚寡欲、尤善玄言；桓温废奕后迎立，在位不及一年，周旋于桓温禅让之请，忧愤而崩。
emperors.summary_en: Youngest son of Emperor Yuan, long a regent, pure and passionless, a master of metaphysical talk; after Huan Wen deposed Emperor Fei he was brought to the throne, reigned under a year, parried Wen's bid for abdication, and died of grief and vexation.

emperors.summary: 十一岁即位，桓温卒后谢安执政，太元八年淝水之战大破苻坚，乘胜北伐；谢安卒后荒于酒色，太元二十一年醉后为张贵人弑于宫中。
emperors.summary_en: Ascending at eleven, he saw Huan Wen die and Xie An govern; in the 8th year of Taiyuan the Battle of the Fei River broke Fu Jian utterly, and he pressed north on the victory; after Xie An's death he gave himself to wine and women, and in the 21st year of Taiyuan, drunk, he was slain in his palace by Lady Zhang.

emperors.summary: 不慧，寒暑不辨，在位二十二年而政归权臣：孙恩乱、桓玄篡、刘裕起兵反正，义熙年间裕灭南燕后秦；义熙十四年为刘裕使人缢杀。
emperors.summary_en: Dull of mind, unable to tell heat from cold, he reigned twenty-two years while strong ministers ruled: Sun En's revolt, Huan Xuan's usurpation, Liu Yu's rising and restoration — in the Yixi years Yu destroyed Southern Yan and Later Qin, and in the 14th year of Yixi he had the emperor strangled.

emperors.summary: 安帝被弑后即位，元熙二年禅位于刘裕，东晋亡；封零陵王，永初二年为刘裕所害。
emperors.summary_en: Ascending after Emperor An's murder, he abdicated to Liu Yu in the 2nd year of Yuanxi, ending Eastern Jin; enfeoffed Duke of Lingling, he was done to death by Liu Yu in the 2nd year of Yongchu.

emperors.summary: 寒门起家，讨桓玄复晋室，灭南燕、破卢循、灭后秦，武功冠于南朝；永初元年受禅称帝，国号宋，为南朝第一帝。
emperors.summary_en: Rising from a common house, he destroyed Huan Xuan to restore the Jin, then destroyed Southern Yan, broke Lu Xun, and ended Later Qin — arms without equal in the southern dynasties; in the 1st year of Yongchu he received the abdication and founded Song, first emperor of the Southern Dynasties.

emperors.summary: 武帝长子，十七岁即位，游戏无度、不亲政事；景平二年为徐羡之等废为营阳王，旋被弑，开南朝权臣废立之例。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Wu, he took the throne at seventeen, playing endlessly and neglecting government; in the 2nd year of Jingping Xu Xianzhi and the others deposed him as Prince of Yingyang and soon slew him — the first deposition by ministers of the southern dynasties.

emperors.summary: 少帝废后自江陵入继，诛徐羡之等亲政；元嘉三十年治世，劝农兴学、户口蕃息，史称「元嘉之治」；然元嘉北伐两败，晚年立嗣不明，为太子劭所弑。
emperors.summary_en: Entering from Jiangling after the Young Emperor's deposition, he slew Xu Xianzhi and the others to rule in person; his thirty years of the Yuanjia era — encouraging farming and learning, households multiplying — are the celebrated "Yuanjia recovery"; but the Yuanjia expeditions failed twice, and in his last years, his succession unsecured, he was slain by his own heir Shao.

emperors.summary: 起兵诛太子劭即位，平南郡王义宣、屠广陵灭竟陵王诞；然多兴土木、赋役烦苛，大明八年崩，前废帝继。
emperors.summary_en: Rising to slay the parricide heir Shao, he took the throne, put down the Prince of Nanjun's revolt, and massacred Guangling to end the Prince of Jingling's; but he raised buildings endlessly and burdened the people with levies. He died in the 8th year of Daming; the Former Deposed Emperor succeeded.

emperors.summary: 孝武长子，十六岁即位，一年数改元，诛杀大臣宗室，朝野震恐；景和元年十一月为寿寂之等弑于华林园，在位一年。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Xiaowu, he took the throne at sixteen, changed eras several times in a year, and slew ministers and princes until court and realm trembled; in the eleventh month of the 1st year of Jinghe he was slain by Shou Jizhi and the others in the Hualin Park — one year on the throne.

emperors.summary: 前废帝被弑后即位，平晋安王子勋之乱，然泰始中淮北尽失；好读书、善隶书，晚年多忌、骨肉相残；泰豫元年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Taking the throne after the Former Deposed Emperor's slaying, he put down the Prince of Jin'an's rising, but in the Tai shi years the Huai north was lost; a reader of books and a fine calligrapher, in his last years he grew jealous and slew his own kin. He died in the 1st year of Taiyu.

emperors.summary: 明帝长子，十岁即位，游戏虐杀无度，朝政归权臣萧道成；元徽五年为道成心腹弑于宫中，立安成王准。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Ming, he took the throne at ten, playing and killing without limit while the strong minister Xiao Daocheng governed; in the 5th year of Yuanhui Daocheng's men slew him in the palace and set up the Prince of Ancheng, Zhun.

emperors.summary: 明帝第三子，十岁即位，实权在萧道成；沈攸之起兵被平，升明三年禅位于萧道成，宋亡，禅后遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Emperor Ming, he took the throne at ten with Xiao Daocheng holding the real power; Shen Youzhi's rising was put down, and in the 3rd year of Shengming he abdicated to Xiao Daocheng — Song was no more, and he was done to death after the abdication.

emperors.summary: 仕宋积军功，平桂阳王休范、沈攸之之乱，废宋自立；受禅称帝，国号齐；性节俭、定礼仪官制，建元四年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Rising by arms under Song, he put down the revolts of the Prince of Guiyang and Shen Youzhi, and took the Song throne; receiving the abdication, he founded Qi. Frugal by nature, he fixed the rites and institutions, and died in the 4th year of Jianyuan.
tags_en: Abdication and the Founding of Qi

emperors.summary: 高帝长子，永明十一年治世，劝农减役、百姓丰乐，史称「永明之治」；与竟陵王西邸文士相善，文学史称永明体；北讨无大功，永明十一年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Gao, his eleven years of the Yongming era — farming encouraged, corvée lightened, the people prosperous — are the celebrated "Yongming recovery"; his friendship with the writers of the Prince of Jingling's western mansion gave the literary age its "Yongming style." The northern campaigns gained nothing, and he died in the 11th year of Yongming.

emperors.summary: 武帝太孙，永明十一年即位；游戏无度，宗室萧鸾以辅政之名废之为郁林王而弑，立海陵王。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of Emperor Wu, he took the throne in the 11th year of Yongming; playing without limit, he was deposed as Prince of Yulin by the prince Xiao Luan — who governed in his name — and slain, Hai ling Wang being set up.

emperors.summary: 文惠太子次子，郁林废后立为帝，改元延兴，在位数月；萧鸾废之为海陵王，旋遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of the Crown Prince Wenhui, he was set up after the Prince of Yulin's deposition, changing the era to Yanxing, and reigned a few months; Xiao Luan deposed him as Prince of Hailing and he was soon done to death.

emperors.summary: 高帝侄，废郁林、海陵自立；建武年间大诛高武诸子，史称惨毒；孝文帝南伐齐边告急，永泰元年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Nephew of Emperor Gao, he deposed the Prince of Yulin and the Prince of Hailing to take the throne; in the Jianwu years he slaughtered the sons of Gaodi and Wudi — the histories call it poison; Emperor Xiaowen of Wei marched south and the border was in peril. He died in the 1st year of Yongtai.

emperors.summary: 明帝次子，即位后诛杀大臣、奢虐无度，潘妃金莲之奢传于后世；萧衍起兵襄阳，中兴元年建康陷落，帝被杀。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Emperor Ming, on the throne he slew his ministers and gave himself to extravagance and cruelty — the golden-lotus stories of Consort Pan passing into legend; Xiao Yan rose from Xiangyang, Jiankang fell in the 1st year of Zhongxing, and the emperor was slain.

emperors.summary: 明帝第八子，萧衍等奉之即位于江陵；中兴二年禅位于萧衍，齐亡，禅后遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Eighth son of Emperor Ming, set up at Jiangling by Xiao Yan and the others; in the 2nd year of Zhongxing he abdicated to Xiao Yan — Qi was no more — and was done to death after the abdication.

emperors.summary: 在位近半个世纪，兴文教、崇佛法，成南朝文化高峰，晚年纳侯景而困死台城的梁朝开国皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The founding emperor of Liang, who reigned for nearly half a century, promoted letters and Buddhist learning to a Southern Dynasties cultural peak, and late in life took in Hou Jing—dying trapped in the besieged palace city of Taicheng.

emperors.summary: 武帝第三子，工诗赋，倡宫体；侯景陷台城后即位，为景傀儡，大宝二年被废遇害，梁室中衰。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Emperor Wu, a fine poet who championed the palace style; enthroned after Hou Jing took the palace, he sat as Jing's puppet and was deposed and slain in the 2nd year of Dabao — the decline of Liang.

emperors.summary: 昭明太子统之孙，侯景废简文后立为帝，改元天正；在位数月，被迫禅位侯景，侯景败后为元帝方面所害，图鉴作准帝。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of the Crown Prince Zhaoming, set up by Hou Jing after the deposition of Emperor Jianwen, he changed the era to Tianzheng; after months he was forced to abdicate to Jing, and after Jing's fall was done to death by Emperor Yuan's party — the gazetteer lists him as quasi-emperor.

emperors.summary: 武帝第七子，平侯景称帝于江陵；承圣二年讨平武陵王纪，承圣三年西魏破江陵，城破被俘杀，聚书十四万卷焚于兵火。
emperors.summary_en: Seventh son of Emperor Wu, he destroyed Hou Jing and took the throne at Jiangling; in the 2nd year of Chengsheng he put down the Prince of Wuling, and in the 3rd year Western Wei broke Jiangling — he was taken and slain, and his library of 140,000 volumes perished in the flames.

emperors.summary: 元帝第九子，江陵陷后即位于建康；陈霸先杀王僧辩、拒北齐，太平二年禅位于霸先，梁亡，禅后遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Ninth son of Emperor Yuan, he took the throne at Jiankang after the fall of Jiangling; Chen Baxian slew Wang Sengbian and held the Qi armies, and in the 2nd year of Taiping the emperor abdicated to Baxian — Liang was no more, and he was slain after the abdication.

emperors.summary: 吴兴寒族起家，讨侯景、破北齐，杀王僧辩专朝政；永定元年受禅称帝，国号陈，三年崩，侄蒨继。
emperors.summary_en: Rising from a common house of Wuxing, he destroyed Hou Jing, broke the Qi armies, slew Wang Sengbian, and took the government; in the 1st year of Yongding he received the abdication and founded Chen. He died in the 3rd year; his nephew Qian succeeded.
tags_en: Abdication and the Founding of Chen

emperors.summary: 武帝侄，永定三年即位，破王琳、安集江南，劝农省役，史称天嘉称治；天康元年崩，子伯宗继。
emperors.summary_en: Nephew of Emperor Wu, he took the throne in the 3rd year of Yongding, broke Wang Lin, and settled the south, urging farming and lightening corvée — the "Tianjia recovery" of the histories. He died in the 1st year of Tiankang; his son Bozong succeeded.

emperors.summary: 文帝长子，十三岁即位，政出叔父安成王顼；光大二年被废为临海王，太建二年薨。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Wen, he took the throne at thirteen with the government in his uncle the Prince of Ancheng's hands; in the 2nd year of Guangda he was deposed as Prince of Linhai and died in the 2nd year of Taijian.

emperors.summary: 文帝弟，废侄伯宗自立；太建五年吴明彻北伐，尽复淮南；北齐亡后争徐兖，吕梁之败，淮南复失，功败垂成；太建十四年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Younger brother of Emperor Wen, he deposed his nephew Bozong; in the 5th year of Taijian Wu Mingche's expedition recovered all the Huainan; after Northern Qi fell he contended for Xu and Yan, was shattered at Lüliang, and the Huainan was lost again — the enterprise failed at the last. He died in the 14th year of Taijian.

emperors.summary: 宣帝长子，大营临春、结绮、望仙诸阁，与张丽华游宴，艳诗《玉树后庭花》成亡国之音；祯明三年隋军入建康，出降，陈亡，南朝终结。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Xuan, he raised the Linchun, Jieqi, and Wangxian pavilions and feasted with Zhang Lihua; his *Jade Trees and Rear-Court Flowers* became the song of a lost realm. In the 3rd year of Zhenming the Sui armies entered Jiankang; he surrendered, Chen perished, and the Southern Dynasties were at an end.
tags_en: The Song of a Lost Realm

emperors.summary: 什翼犍之孙，代亡后复国，大会牛川即代王位，改称魏王；参合陂大破后燕、取并州、迁都平城称帝，离散部落、计口授田，北魏开国之基；晚年猜暴，天赐六年遇弑。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of Shiyijian, he restored the state after Dai's fall, taking the throne at the Niuchuan assembly as King of Dai, then King of Wei; shattering Later Yan at the Canhe marshes, taking Bingzhou, and moving the capital to Pingcheng, he took the imperial throne, dissolved the tribes, and allotted land by mouth — the foundations of Northern Wei. In his last years jealous and cruel, he was slain in the 6th year of Tianci.

emperors.summary: 道武帝长子，父被弑后平乱即位；乘刘裕灭后秦之机取河南，尽有司兖豫淮北之地；立太子监国制，泰常八年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Daowu, he put down the rebellion after his father's slaying and took the throne; riding Liu Yu's conquest of Later Qin, he took Henan and held Si, Yan, Yu, and the Huai north; he established the heir's regency and died in the 8th year of Taichang.

emperors.summary: 以铁骑灭胡夏、北燕、北凉而统一北方，又南征临江、晚年灭佛，武功极盛而终被近侍所弑的北魏皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The Northern Wei emperor whose iron cavalry destroyed Hu Xia, Northern Yan, and Northern Liang to unify the north; he campaigned south to the Yangzi and suppressed Buddhism in his late years, and at the height of his military power was murdered by a close attendant.

emperors.summary: 太武帝孙，宗爱弑太武后入定乱即位；兴安二年下诏复佛法，和平元年昙曜开云冈石窟，与民休息；和平六年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of Emperor Taiwu, he entered and steadied the realm after Zong Ai slew Taiwu; in the 2nd year of Xing'an he restored the Buddhist law by edict, and in the 1st year of Heping Tanyao opened the Yungang caves; he let the people rest. He died in the 6th year of Heping.

emperors.summary: 文成帝长子，年幼即位，冯太后临朝；诛乙浑后亲政，好黄老浮屠，志在恬退；皇兴五年禅位太子宏，自称太上皇，承明元年暴崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Wencheng, he took the throne young under Empress Feng's regency; after slaying Yi Hun he ruled in person, loving Huang–Lao and the Buddha, his mind set on withdrawal; in the 5th year of Huangxing he abdicated to his heir Hong and called himself Grand Emperor, dying suddenly in the 1st year of Chengming.

emperors.summary: 幼年即位，承太和新政之基，迁都洛阳、全面推行汉化改制，深刻重塑北魏并影响隋唐制度的皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The Northern Wei emperor who took the throne as a child, built on the Taihe New Policies, moved the capital to Luoyang, and pursued wholesale sinicization, profoundly reshaping the dynasty and influencing Sui–Tang institutions.

emperors.summary: 孝文帝第二子，孝文崩于南伐后即位；景明元年罢六辅亲政，与梁争淮南义阳，洛阳伽蓝极盛；延昌四年崩，胡太后预政。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Emperor Xiaowen, he took the throne after Xiaowen's death on the southern campaign; in the 1st year of Jingming he dismissed the six regents and ruled in person, contending with Liang for Huainan and Yiyang while Luoyang's monasteries flourished. He died in the 4th year of Yanchang; Empress Hu entered the government.

emperors.summary: 宣武帝第二子，六岁即位，胡太后临朝；正光元年元叉幽太后专政，正光四年六镇起义起；武泰元年帝暴崩，胡太后立幼主，尔朱荣南下——北魏自此而衰。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Xuanwu, he took the throne at six under Empress Hu's regency; in the 1st year of Zhengguang Yuan Cha confined the empress and ruled, and in the 4th year the Six Garrisons rose; in the 1st year of Wutai the emperor died suddenly, Empress Hu set up an infant, and Erzhu Rong marched south — the decline of Northern Wei began.

emperors.summary: 彭城王勰第三子，尔朱荣立之；即位即逢河阴之变，王公卿士二千余人沉河；永安三年于明光殿手刃尔朱荣，旋为尔朱兆所弑于晋阳。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of the Prince of Pengcheng, set up by Erzhu Rong; his accession opened with the Heyin massacre, over two thousand princes and ministers drowned in the river; in the 3rd year of Yong'an he slew Erzhu Rong with his own hand in the Mingguang Hall, and was soon done to death by Erzhu Zhao at Jinyang.

emperors.summary: 广陵王羽之子，尔朱世隆等立为帝；在位约一年，傀儡于尔朱氏，普泰二年高欢入洛被废，寻遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Son of the Prince of Guangling, Yuan Yu, set up by Erzhu Shilong and the others; about a year he reigned as the Erzhu's puppet, until Gao Huan entered Luoyang in the 2nd year of Putai and deposed him; he was soon done to death.

emperors.summary: 广平武穆王怀第三子，高欢立之；不甘受制，永熙三年西奔长安依宇文泰，旋遇鸩——北魏由此分为东西。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of the Prince of Guangping, Yuan Huai, set up by Gao Huan; unable to bear the restraint, in the 3rd year of Yongxi he fled west to Chang'an and Xiao Wentai, and was soon poisoned — Northern Wei split into east and west.

emperors.summary: 清河王亶子，孝武西奔后高欢立之，迁都邺，东魏始；聪慧好文，然傀儡于高氏，武定八年禅位高洋，寻遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Son of the Prince of Qinghe, Yuan Dan; set up by Gao Huan after Xiaowu fled west, he moved the capital to Ye — the beginning of Eastern Wei. Sharp and fond of letters, he sat as the Gao house's puppet, abdicated to Gao Yang in the 8th year of Wuding, and was soon done to death.

emperors.summary: 京兆王愉之子，孝文帝孙；孝武遇鸩后宇文泰立之，都长安，西魏始；大统三年沙苑之战破高欢，西魏立足，府兵制萌芽；大统十七年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Son of the Prince of Jingzhao, Yuan Yu, grandson of Emperor Xiaowen; after Xiaowu's poisoning Yuwen Tai set him up at Chang'an — the beginning of Western Wei. In the 3rd year of Datong the Shayuan battle broke Gao Huan and Western Wei stood; the fubing system began to take shape. He died in the 17th year of Datong.

names.display_en: The Deposed Emperor of Western Wei

emperors.summary: 文帝长子，三年无年号；谋除宇文泰事泄，废为安定公，旋遇害；其在位时西魏破江陵、灭梁元帝。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Wen, he reigned three years without an era name; his plot against Yuwen Tai leaked, he was deposed as Duke of Anding and soon done to death; in his reign Western Wei broke Jiangling and destroyed Emperor Yuan of Liang.

emperors.summary: 文帝第四子，废帝被废后立为帝；宇文泰卒后，其侄宇文觉受禅，西魏亡，禅后遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Fourth son of Emperor Wen, set up after the Deposed Emperor's fall; when Yuwen Tai died, his nephew Yuwen Jue received the abdication — Western Wei was no more — and the emperor was done to death after the abdication.

emperors.summary: 高欢第二子，受禅代东魏称帝，国号齐，都邺；初勤政、北讨山胡契丹、筑长城，后以酒狂杀戮，史极言之；天保十年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Gao Huan, he received the abdication of Eastern Wei and took the throne as Qi with its capital at Ye; diligent at first — campaigning north against the mountain Hu and the Khitan and building the Great Wall — he later drowned in wine and killed without measure, the histories condemning him utterly. He died in the 10th year of Tianbao.
tags_en: The Abdication and the Founding of Qi

names.display_en: The Deposed Emperor of Northern Qi

emperors.summary: 文宣长子，十五岁即位；幼而好学，然不能自固，皇建元年为叔父常山王演所废为济南王，旋遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Wenxuan, he took the throne at fifteen; studious from youth but unable to hold his own, in the 1st year of Huangjian his uncle the Prince of Changshan, Yan, deposed him as Prince of Jinan, and he was soon done to death.

emperors.summary: 高欢第六子，废侄高殷自立；留心政事、明察俭约，欲革文宣之弊；皇建二年亲征库莫奚，坠马伤重而崩，传位弟湛。
emperors.summary_en: Sixth son of Gao Huan, he deposed his nephew Yin to take the throne; attentive to government, clear-sighted and frugal, he meant to repair Wenxuan's evils; in the 2nd year of Huangjian, campaigning in person against the Kumo Xi, he fell from his horse, his hurt mortal, and died, passing the throne to his brother Zhan.

emperors.summary: 高欢第九子，孝昭崩后即位，改元太宁、河清，颁律令；然荒淫委任佞幸，河清四年禅位太子纬，自称太上皇，天统五年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Ninth son of Gao Huan, he took the throne after Xiaozhao's death, changing the eras to Taining and Heqing and issuing the statutes; but he gave himself to debauchery and trusted flatterers, and in the 4th year of Heqing abdicated to his heir Wei, styling himself Grand Emperor. He died in the 5th year of Tiantong.

names.display_en: The Last Sovereign of Northern Qi

emperors.summary: 武成长子，十岁即位；好弹琵琶作无愁曲，史称「无愁天子」；武平三年听谗杀名将斛律光，周武帝乘隙灭齐，被俘，北齐亡。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Wucheng, he took the throne at ten; fond of the pipa and its "song without sorrow," the histories call him the "Sorrowless Sovereign"; in the 3rd year of Wuping, on slander, he slew the great general Hulü Guang, and Emperor Wu of Zhou struck through the gap and destroyed Qi — he was taken, and Northern Qi was no more.

emperors.summary: 宇文泰第三子，泰卒后受西魏恭帝禅位称天王，国号周；初称天王未称皇帝；同年谋宇文护事泄，废为略阳公，旋被弑。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Yuwen Tai, after Tai's death he received the abdication of the Gong emperor of Western Wei, taking the title Heavenly King of the realm Zhou; he bore the title of king, not yet emperor; that same year his plot against Yuwen Hu leaked, he was deposed as Duke of Lüeyang, and soon slain.
tags_en: The Abdication and the Founding of Zhou

emperors.summary: 宇文泰长子，孝闵被废后继位称天王；武成元年改称皇帝；宽明仁厚、好学能诗，然军国一决于宇文护，武成二年为护所鸩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Yuwen Tai, he succeeded after Xiaomin's deposition, first as Heavenly King, then in the 1st year of Wucheng taking the title of emperor; generous and learned, a poet, yet the armies and the realm decided by Yuwen Hu, who poisoned him in the 2nd year of Wucheng.

emperors.summary: 宇文泰第四子，明帝遗诏继位；建德元年于宫中诛宇文护，亲总万机；建德三年灭佛道二教；建德六年亲征灭北齐，统一北方；宣政元年北伐突厥道病崩。
emperors.summary_en: Fourth son of Yuwen Tai, he succeeded by Ming's will; in the 1st year of Jiande he slew Yuwen Hu in the palace and took up the government himself; in the 3rd year he proscribed Buddhism and Daoism; in the 6th year, campaigning in person, he destroyed Northern Qi and united the north; in the 1st year of Xuanzheng, on the campaign against the Turks, he fell ill and died.

emperors.summary: 武帝长子，即位后自比上帝，立四皇后，刑杀无度，史称天元侈暴；大象元年禅位太子阐，自称天元皇帝，大象二年崩，杨坚辅政。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Emperor Wu, on the throne he compared himself to God, set up four empresses at once, and punished and slew without measure — the histories call him the extravagant Heavenly Sovereign; in the 1st year of Daxiang he abdicated to his heir Chan, styling himself the Heavenly Emperor Tianyuan, and died in the 2nd year, leaving Yang Jian regent.

emperors.summary: 宣帝长子，七岁即位，杨坚为左大丞相；大象二年平尉迟迥等反抗；大定元年禅位于杨坚，周亡隋立，禅后遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Xuan, he took the throne at seven with Yang Jian as grand chancellor of the left; in the 2nd year of Daxiang the risings of Yuchi Jiong and the rest were put down; in the 1st year of Dading he abdicated to Yang Jian — Zhou perished, Sui arose, and he was done to death after the abdication.

names.display_en: Liu Yuan, Founder of Han (Former Zhao)

emperors.summary: 乘八王之乱于离石起兵，称大单于、汉王，以绍汉为号召；永嘉二年称帝迁都平阳，为十六国割据开端之首，史称聪敏好学。
emperors.summary_en: Rising at Lishi amid the War of the Eight Princes, he styled himself Great Chanyu and King of Han in succession to the Han house; in the 2nd year of Yongjia he took the throne and moved his capital to Pingyang, opening the Sixteen States era — the histories praise his quickness and love of learning.

names.display_en: Liu Cong, Ancestor Lie of Han (Former Zhao)

emperors.summary: 杀兄和自立，在位八年；永嘉五年陷洛阳俘怀帝，建兴四年陷长安灭西晋，武功极盛；然游猎无度、后宫侈靡，史载记批评之甚。
emperors.summary_en: He slew his brother He to take the throne and reigned eight years; in the 5th year of Yongjia he took Luoyang and captured Emperor Huai, and in the 4th of Jianxing took Chang'an and ended Western Jin — his arms at their height; but his hunting and his harem drew the historians' sharpest censure.

names.display_en: Liu Yao, Sovereign of Zhao (Former Zhao)

emperors.summary: 靳准之乱后即帝位，迁都长安，改国号赵，立太学、造浑仪；太宁三年与石勒决战洛阳，兵败被俘，翌年遇害，前赵亡。
emperors.summary_en: After the Jin Zhun troubles he took the throne, moved the capital to Chang'an, and changed the realm's name to Zhao, founding an academy and casting an armillary sphere; in the 3rd year of Taining he met Shi Le at Luoyang, was taken prisoner, and died the next year — Former Zhao was at an end.

emperors.summary: 从被掠卖为奴的羯人少年到开国称帝，都襄国、灭前赵而臣北方，十六国最具戏剧性的创业者。
emperors.summary_en: A Jie youth kidnapped and sold into slavery who rose to found an empire — ruling from Xiangguo, he destroyed Former Zhao and made the north submit, the most dramatic state-founder of the Sixteen Kingdoms.

names.display_en: Shi Hu, Martial Emperor of Later Zhao

emperors.summary: 石勒侄，废杀石弘自立，迁都邺，后赵武功极盛；然暴虐著称，营宫室、兴大役、好杀伐，死后诸子争立，后赵迅即崩溃。
emperors.summary_en: Nephew of Shi Le, he deposed and slew Shi Hong to take the throne, moved the capital to Ye, and carried Later Zhao to its height of power; but his tyranny is proverbial — palaces, corvée, and slaughter — and after his death his sons fought, and Later Zhao collapsed at once.

names.display_en: Li Xiong, Grand Ancestor of Cheng Han

emperors.summary: 巴氐流民首领李特之子，继统部众，称成都王、即帝位，国号大成，都成都；在位三十年，赋役较轻、蜀人安之，为十六国中最善治者之一。
emperors.summary_en: Son of the Ba-Di refugee leader Li Te, he took over the host, styled himself King of Chengdu, then emperor of the realm Dacheng with its capital at Chengdu; in thirty years of light levies and easy rule the Shu people were content — one of the most benign of the Sixteen States' sovereigns.

names.display_en: Murong Huang, Emperor Wenming of Former Yan

emperors.summary: 慕容廆之子，嗣辽东公，自称燕王，筑龙城而都之，破宇文部、拓辽西，前燕王政自此始；永和四年崩，子儁继。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Murong Hui, he succeeded as Duke of Liaodong, styled himself King of Yan, built Longcheng as his capital, broke the Yuwen tribe, and extended Liaoxi — the kingship of Former Yan began here; he died in the 4th year of Yonghe and his son Jun succeeded.

names.display_en: Murong Jun, Emperor Jingzhao of Former Yan

emperors.summary: 嗣燕王，乘后赵之乱南进中原，永和八年俘杀冉闵，即皇帝位；迁都邺，前燕全盛；光寿四年崩，子暐幼继，慕容恪辅政。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding as King of Yan, he pressed south into the Central Plains amid the chaos of Later Zhao; in the 8th year of Yonghe he captured and slew Ran Min and took the imperial throne; moving the capital to Ye, Former Yan reached its height. He died in the 4th year of Guangshou, his child heir Wei under Murong Ke's regency.

names.display_en: Fu Jian (Jian), Founder of Former Qin

emperors.summary: 苻洪之子，统众入关据长安，自称天王、大单于，国号大秦，旋称帝；皇始中坚壁清野拒桓温北伐，前秦基业始固；皇始五年崩，子生继而残虐。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Fu Hong, he led the host into the pass, took Chang'an, styled himself Heavenly King and Great Chanyu of the realm Great Qin, then emperor; in mid-Huangshi he denied Huan Wen's expedition by clearing the land, and the Qin foundations were set. He died in the 5th year of Huangshi, his cruel son Sheng succeeding.

emperors.summary: 任用王猛治国，灭前燕、前凉而统一北方，终因倾国伐晋败于淝水、国解身死的前秦君主。
emperors.summary_en: The Former Qin ruler who governed through Wang Meng, destroyed Former Yan and Former Liang to unify the north, and finally hurled the whole state against Jin, lost at the Fei River, and saw his realm dissolve and himself perish.

names.display_en: Yao Chang, Founder of Later Qin

emperors.summary: 南安赤亭羌，姚弋仲子；淝水之战后叛苻坚自立，称万年秦王，围新平缢杀苻坚，即帝位于长安，国号大秦；建初八年崩，子兴继。
emperors.summary_en: A Qiang of Chiting in Nan'an, son of Yao Yizhong; after the Fei River defeat he turned against Fu Jian, styled himself King of Wannian Qin, besieged Xinping, and had Fu Jian strangled; he took the throne at Chang'an as the realm Great Qin. He died in the 8th year of Jianchu, his son Xing succeeding.

names.display_en: Yao Xing, High Ancestor of Later Qin

emperors.summary: 姚苌子，即位后破苻登、灭前秦残部，基本统一关陇；弘始三年迎鸠摩罗什入长安译经，大营塔寺，佛教极盛；又立律学、兴学校；晚年立嗣不明，永和元年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Yao Chang, on his accession he broke Fu Deng, destroyed the remnants of Former Qin, and roughly united Guanzhong and Longxi; in the 3rd year of Hongshi he brought Kumarajiva to Chang'an to translate the scriptures, raised monasteries and pagodas, and Buddhism flourished; he also founded a law academy and schools. His succession was ill-managed, and he died in the 1st year of Yonghe.

names.display_en: Murong Chui, Martial Emperor of Later Yan

emperors.summary: 前燕名将，奔秦仕苻坚；淝水败后叛秦，称燕王于荥阳，即帝位于中山，后燕开国；参合陂之败后亲征北魏，病崩于上谷，后燕中衰。
emperors.summary_en: The great general of Former Yan, he fled to serve Fu Jian; after the Fei River defeat he turned on Qin, styled himself King of Yan at Xingyang, and took the throne at Zhongshan — founding Later Yan; after the Canhe marshes disaster he campaigned in person against Northern Wei, fell ill, and died at Shanggu, and Later Yan declined.

names.display_en: Qifu Guoren, Ancestor Lie of Western Qin

emperors.summary: 陇西鲜卑乞伏部首领，淝水战后据苑川称大单于，击破邻近鲜卑诸部，受前秦官爵；建义四年崩，弟乾归继，西秦延续。
emperors.summary_en: Chief of the Qifu Xianbei of Longxi, after the Fei River defeat he held Yuanchuan and styled himself Great Chanyu, broke the neighboring Xianbei tribes, and accepted Former Qin's titles; he died in the 4th year of Jianyi, his brother Gangui carrying on Western Qin.

names.display_en: Lü Guang, Martial Emperor of Later Liang

emperors.summary: 略阳氐，苻坚大将；建元十九年征西域，破龟兹，得鸠摩罗什；东还闻苻坚败，据姑臧自立，称凉州牧，后称三河王、天王；承康元年崩，诸子争立，后凉分裂。
emperors.summary_en: A Di of Lüeyang and a general of Fu Jian; in the 19th year of Jianyuan he campaigned in the Western Regions, broke Kucha, and brought back Kumarajiva; returning east on word of Fu Jian's fall, he held Guzang, styled himself Governor of Liangzhou, then King of the Three Rivers and Heavenly King. He died in the 1st year of Chengkang as his sons fought — Later Liang split apart.

names.display_en: Tufa Wugu, Martial King of Southern Liang

emperors.summary: 河西鲜卑秃发部首领，叛后凉称西平王，筑廉川堡为都，拓地广武，改称武威王，南凉始；太初三年酒醉坠马伤肋而崩，弟利鹿孤继。
emperors.summary_en: Chief of the Tufa Xianbei of Hexi, he turned against Later Liang, styled himself King of Xiping, built Lianchuan as his capital, extended his lands to Guangwu, and took the title King of Wuwei — the beginning of Southern Liang. In the 3rd year of Taichu, drunk, he fell from his horse and died of the hurt; his brother Lilugu succeeded.

names.display_en: Juqu Mengxun, King Wuxuan of Northern Liang

emperors.summary: 临松卢水胡，博涉群史；推段业为凉州牧，旋杀业自立，称凉州牧、张掖公，北凉实始；迁都姑臧称河西王，玄始十年破敦煌灭西凉，一统河西大部；义和三年崩。
emperors.summary_en: A Lushui Hu of Linsong, learned in the histories; he pushed Duan Ye to the governorship of Liangzhou, then slew Ye and stood himself, styling himself Governor of Liangzhou and Duke of Zhangye — the real beginning of Northern Liang. Moving the capital to Guzang, he took the title King of Hexi; in the 10th year of Xuanshi he broke Dunhuang, destroyed Western Liang, and united most of Hexi. He died in the 3rd year of Yihe.

names.display_en: Li Gao, Founder of Western Liang

emperors.summary: 陇西成纪人，好文学；庚子元年于敦煌称凉公，西凉始；迁都酒泉，立泮宫、增高门学生，劝课农桑；嘉兴元年崩，子歆继，后为沮渠蒙逊所灭。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Chengji in Longxi, a lover of letters; in the 1st year of Gengzi he styled himself Duke of Liang at Dunhuang — the beginning of Western Liang. Moving the capital to Jiuquan, he founded an academy, enlarged the students, and encouraged farming and mulberries. He died in the 1st year of Jiaxing; his son Xin succeeded, and the realm was later destroyed by Juqu Mengxun.

names.display_en: Helian Bobo, Ancestor Shi of Xia

emperors.summary: 匈奴铁弗部，刘卫辰子；叛后秦称天王、大单于，国号大夏；发民夫十万筑统万城，蒸土夯筑，极侈且酷；乘刘裕北还取长安称帝；真兴七年崩，子昌继，后为魏所灭。
emperors.summary_en: A Tie Fu Xiongnu, son of Liu Weichen; turning against Later Qin, he styled himself Heavenly King and Great Chanyu of the realm Great Xia; driving a hundred thousand laborers, he built Tongwan with steamed earth pounded hard — sumptuous and cruel beyond measure; riding Liu Yu's return north, he took Chang'an and the imperial throne. He died in the 7th year of Zhenxing; his son Chang succeeded, and Wei destroyed the realm.

names.display_en: Feng Ba, Emperor Wencheng of Northern Yan

emperors.summary: 汉人冯氏，杀后燕慕容熙，推高云，云被杀后即天王位，都龙城；省徭薄赋、安集流民，与柔然和亲，保境二十余年；太平二十二年崩，弟弘杀太子自立，后亡于魏。
emperors.summary_en: A Han of the Feng house, he slew the Later Yan emperor Murong Xi, set up Gao Yun, and when Yun was slain took the heavenly throne himself at Longcheng; lightening corvée and taxes and gathering the refugees, he married peace with the Rouran and held his borders over twenty years. He died in the 22nd year of Taiping; his brother Hong slew the heir to take the throne, and Wei later destroyed the realm.

names.display_en: Zhang Gui, Martial King of Former Liang

emperors.summary: 安定乌氏人，永宁元年出为凉州刺史，据河西；破鲜卑若罗拔能，威行河西；中原大乱中保境安民、贡献不绝，前凉基业始；建兴二年卒，谥武公。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Wushi in Anding, in the 1st year of Yongning he was made governor of Liangzhou and held Hexi; breaking the Xianbei Ruoluo Baneng, his name ran through Hexi; amid the collapse of the Central Plains he kept his borders and his people and never ceased tribute — the foundations of Former Liang. He died in the 2nd year of Jianxing, posthumously Duke Wu.

emperors.summary: 拓跋郁律子，质于后赵；即代王位，建元建国，都云中盛乐，始制法律、分土定居；屡北征高车、西击卫辰，代北强盛；建国三十九年为前秦所灭，北魏追尊昭成皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Tuoba Yulü, hostage in Later Zhao in his youth; taking the throne as King of Dai, he opened the era Jianguo with his capital at Shengle in Yunzhong, first made laws, and moved toward settled lands; campaigning north against the Gaoche and west against Weichen, the Dai realm grew strong in the north. In the 39th year of Jianguo Former Qin destroyed it; Northern Wei later honored him as Emperor Zhaocheng.

emperors.summary: 1038年称帝建大夏，创西夏文、立番汉官制，三败宋军而与宋辽鼎立的西夏开国之主。
emperors.summary_en: The founding ruler of Western Xia, who proclaimed himself emperor of Great Xia in 1038, created the Tangut script and a dual Tangut–Han official system, defeated Song armies three times, and stood as a third power alongside Song and Liao.

emperors.summary: 庐州合肥人；唐末据淮南，为淮南节度使，都扬州；乾宁中破孙儒，定江淮；天复二年唐封吴王；保境息民，江淮小康；天祐二年卒。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Hefei in Luzhou; in the late Tang he held Huainan as military governor with his seat at Yangzhou; in mid-Qianning he destroyed Sun Ru and fixed the Jiang-Huai; in the 2nd year of Tianfu Tang made him King of Wu; he kept his borders and rested his people, and the Jiang-Huai knew modest peace. He died in the 2nd year of Tianyou.

names.display_en: Yang Pu, Emperor Rui of Wu

emperors.summary: 行密第四子；兄隆演卒后即位，徐温、徐知诰父子相继辅政；乾贞元年称帝；天祚三年禅位于徐知诰（李昪），吴亡。
emperors.summary_en: Fourth son of Xingmi; he took the throne after his brother Longyan's death, with Xu Wen and then Xu Zhigao governing; in the 1st year of Qianzhen he took the imperial title; in the 3rd year of Tianzuo he abdicated to Xu Zhigao (Li Bian) — Wu was no more.

names.display_en: Li Bian, Ancestor Lie of Southern Tang

emperors.summary: 徐州人，徐温养子，名知诰；昇元元年受吴禅即帝位，国号齐，旋改唐，都金陵；昇元中复姓李，改名昪，称唐后；息兵保境、劝农桑；昇元七年崩。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Xuzhou, adopted son of Xu Wen, named Zhigao; in the 1st year of Shengyuan he received the Wu abdication as the realm Qi, soon renamed Tang, with its capital at Jinling; in mid-Shengyuan he resumed the surname Li, took the name Bian, and claimed descent from the Tang house; he stilled the wars, kept his borders, and urged farming. He died in the 7th year of Shengyuan.

names.display_en: Li Jing, Yuan Zong of Southern Tang

emperors.summary: 昪长子；保大元年即位；保大中出兵灭闽（部分）；好文学，与冯延巳等，词风婉约；交泰元年周世宗南伐，璟去帝号称国主，割江北；建隆二年迁都洪州，崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Bian; he took the throne in the 1st year of Baoda and in mid-Baoda sent armies to destroy part of Min; a lover of letters, with Feng Yansi and the rest, his ci verse elegant and soft; in the 1st year of Jiaotai Emperor Shizong of Zhou campaigned south, Jing dropped the imperial title for "ruler," ceding the lands north of the Yangzi; in the 2nd year of Jianlong he moved the capital to Hongzhou and died.
tags_en: The North of the River Lost

names.display_en: Li Yu, Last Ruler of Southern Tang

emperors.summary: 继位于金陵、对宋称臣求存而终至亡国，以词章成就远超君道事功留名后世的南唐末主。
emperors.summary_en: The last ruler of Southern Tang, who succeeded at Jinling, prolonged the state's survival by submitting as a vassal to the Song until its final fall, and is remembered for ci-poetry achievements that far outshine his record as a sovereign.

emperors.summary: 杭州临安人；开平元年梁封吴越王，据两浙；筑捍海塘，治钱塘江堤，保杭嘉；对中原称臣纳贡，保境安民；长兴三年卒。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Lin'an in Hangzhou; in the 1st year of Kaiping Liang made him King of Wuyue, holding the two Zhe; he built the sea wall, diking the Qiantang to protect Hang and Jia; a vassal paying tribute to the Central Plains, he kept his borders and his people. He died in the 3rd year of Changxing.

emperors.summary: 光州固始人；随王绪入闽，乾宁中继兄潮为威武军节度使，据福州；开平三年梁封闽王，都福州；轻徭薄赋、招徕海商，闽人称贤；同光三年卒。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Gushi in Guangzhou; he entered Min with Wang Xu and, in mid-Qianning, succeeded his brother Chao as military governor of the Weiwu army, holding Fuzhou; in the 3rd year of Kaiping Liang made him King of Min with his seat at Fuzhou; he lightened the levies, drew in the sea merchants, and the people of Min called him worthy. He died in the 3rd year of Tongguang.

names.display_en: Wang Yanjun, Emperor Huizong of Min

emperors.summary: 审知次子；天成元年延翰被杀，延钧继，后称帝改元；好神仙，大兴土木；永和元年为子昶等所弑。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Shenzhi; in the 1st year of Tiancheng Yanhan was slain and Yanjun succeeded, later taking the imperial title and changing the era; he loved the immortals and raised great works; in the 1st year of Yonghe he was slain by his son Chang and the others.

names.display_en: Ma Yin, King Wumu of Chu

emperors.summary: 许州鄢陵人；乾宁中随孙儒余部入湖南，据潭州；开平元年梁封楚王，据湖南；兴茶商，听民自采茶卖，收税富国；长兴元年卒，诸子争立。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Yanling in Xuzhou; in mid-Qianning he entered Hunan with Sun Ru's remnant and held Tanzhou; in the 1st year of Kaiping Liang made him King of Chu, holding Hunan; he promoted the tea trade, letting the people gather and sell tea and taxing it to enrich the state. He died in the 1st year of Changxing, his sons contending.

names.display_en: Liu Yan, Emperor Gaozu of Southern Han

emperors.summary: 上蔡人；乾化中继兄隐为清海节度使，据岭南；乾亨元年于番禺称帝，国号大越，旋改汉；有并岭南之功，然酷刑奢侈，史极言之；大有十五年卒。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Shangcai; in mid-Qianhua he succeeded his brother Yin as military governor of Qinghai, holding Lingnan; in the 1st year of Qianheng he took the throne at Panyu as the realm Great Yue, soon renamed Han; he united Lingnan by merit, but his cruel punishments and luxury the histories condemn utterly. He died in the 15th year of Dayou.

names.display_en: Wang Jian, Emperor Gaozu of Former Shu
names.posthumous: 神武圣文孝德明惠皇帝

emperors.summary: 许州舞阳人；大顺中攻陈敬瑄，据两川；天复中唐封蜀王；梁篡唐，建称帝，国号蜀，都成都；光天元年崩，子衍继。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Wuyang in Xuzhou; in mid-Dashun he attacked Chen Jingxuan and held the two Chuan; in mid-Tianfu Tang made him King of Shu; when Liang usurped Tang, Jian took the imperial title as the realm Shu with its capital at Chengdu. He died in the 1st year of Guangtian; his son Yan succeeded.

names.display_en: Wang Yan, The Last Sovereign of Former Shu

emperors.summary: 建幼子；光天元年即位；游宴无度，与韩昭等为小词，不理政事；咸康元年唐军入蜀，衍降，前蜀亡；同光中押送途中被杀。
emperors.summary_en: Youngest son of Jian; he took the throne in the 1st year of Guangtian; feasting without limit, writing little verses with Han Zhao and the rest, careless of government; in the 1st year of Xiankang the Tang army entered Shu, Yan surrendered, and Former Shu was no more; in mid-Tongguang he was slain on the way to custody.

names.display_en: Meng Zhixiang, Emperor Gaozu of Later Shu
names.posthumous: 文武圣德英烈明孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 邢州人，后唐西川节度使；同光三年唐灭前蜀，知祥为成都尹、西川节度；长兴中拒明宗，据蜀自固，并东川破董璋；明德元年称帝，国号蜀，数月崩。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Xingzhou, military governor of Xichuan under Later Tang; when Tang destroyed Former Shu in the 3rd year of Tongguang, Zhixiang became governor of Chengdu and Xichuan; in mid-Changxing he defied Mingzong, held Shu, and destroyed Dong Chuan's Dong Zhang; in the 1st year of Mingde he took the imperial title as the realm Shu, and died within months.

names.display_en: Meng Chang, The Last Sovereign of Later Shu

emperors.summary: 知祥第三子；明德元年即位；蜀中相对安定，好文学，升平文治；乾德三年王全斌伐蜀，昶降，后蜀亡；至京师封秦国公，卒。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Zhixiang; he took the throne in the 1st year of Mingde; Shu was comparatively at peace, and he loved letters — an age of culture; in the 3rd year of Qiande Wang Quanbin invaded, Chang surrendered, and Later Shu was no more; brought to the capital, he was made Duke of Qin and died.

names.display_en: Gao Jixing, King Wuxin of Nanping

emperors.summary: 陕州硖石人；开平元年梁以季兴为荆南节度使；同光二年唐封南平王；据江陵弹丸之地，诸国商贾过境抽税，史称高赖子；天成三年卒。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Xiashi in Shanzhou; in the 1st year of Kaiping Liang made Jixing military governor of Jingnan; in the 2nd year of Tongguang Tang made him King of Nanping; holding the sliver of Jiangling, he taxed the merchants of every state passing through — the histories call him the "Gao rascal." He died in the 3rd year of Tiancheng.

names.display_en: Liu Chong, Founder of Northern Han

emperors.summary: 知远弟，河东节度使；乾祐四年郭威建周，崇于太原称帝，国号汉，依契丹，称侄皇帝；乾祐七年联契丹攻周，败于高平，寻卒。
emperors.summary_en: Younger brother of Zhiyuan, governor of Hedong; in the 4th year of Qianyou, when Guo Wei founded Zhou, Chong took the throne at Taiyuan as the realm Han, leaning on the Khitan and calling himself their nephew emperor; in the 7th year of Qianyou he attacked Zhou with the Khitan, was shattered at Gaoping, and died soon after.

names.display_en: Liu Jun, Emperor Ruizong of Northern Han

emperors.summary: 崇次子；乾祐七年即位，事辽益恭，岁贡契丹换取支援；宋太祖屡攻太原不克；天会十二年卒，国祚延至 979 灭。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Chong; he took the throne in the 7th year of Qianyou, serving Liao ever more humbly, paying yearly tribute for support; Emperor Taizu of Song attacked Taiyuan again and again without taking it; he died in the 12th year of Tianhui, the realm lasting until its fall in 979.

emperors.summary: 受禅代周、灭陈混一南北，以开皇制度奠定后世政制底盘，却因晚年废立与二世而亡留下争议的开国之主。
emperors.summary_en: Founding ruler who received Northern Zhou's abdication to establish the Sui and destroyed Chen to reunify north and south, laying the institutional foundation for later dynasties through the Kaihuang system, yet left controversy through the late-life change of heir and the dynasty's fall in the second generation.

emperors.summary: 由晋王平陈立功而立为太子，即位后营东都、开运河、西巡张掖、三征高句丽，把大工程与大征伐推向极致并致隋速亡的皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The emperor who, made crown prince after earning merit in the conquest of Chen as Prince of Jin, went on to build the Eastern Capital, dig the canals, tour west to Zhangye, and campaign three times against Goguryeo, pushing grand projects and great campaigns to the extreme and bringing the Sui to a swift end.

emperors.summary: 元德太子昭之子，炀帝之孙；李渊入长安立为帝，改元义宁，遥尊炀帝为太上皇；义宁二年禅位于李渊，隋亡，封鄜国公，寻薨。
emperors.summary_en: Son of the Crown Prince Zhao, grandson of Emperor Yang; set up by Li Yuan after he entered Chang'an, changing the era to Yining and honoring Emperor Yang as Grand Emperor from afar; in the 2nd year of Yining he abdicated to Li Yuan — Sui perished — and, made Duke of Fu, died soon after.

emperors.summary: 陇西成纪人，唐国公李昞之子；隋末留守太原，大业十三年太原起兵，克长安立恭帝；武德元年受禅称帝，国号唐；玄武门之变后传位太宗，称太上皇。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Chengji in Longxi, son of the Duke of Tang, Li Bing; in the last years of Sui he held Taiyuan, rose in the 13th year of Daye, took Chang'an, and set up Emperor Gong; in the 1st year of Wude he received the abdication and founded Tang. After the Xuanwu Gate incident he yielded the throne to Emperor Taizong and styled himself Grand Emperor.

emperors.summary: 经玄武门即位，以贞观之治与开明用人著称，并在北境与辽东方向留下鲜明军政轨迹的唐代皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The Tang emperor who took the throne through the Xuanwu Gate Incident, famed for the governance of the Zhenguan era and enlightened employment of talent, leaving a distinct military-political track on the northern frontier and toward Liaodong.

emperors.summary: 太宗第九子，长孙皇后所生；永徽年间承贞观遗风；废王立武、立武后，显庆后风眩委政于武后；总章元年平高丽；弘道元年崩，武后临朝。
emperors.summary_en: Ninth son of Emperor Taizong by Empress Zhangsun; his Yonghui years carried on the Zhenguan legacy; deposing Empress Wang for Wu, he made Wu empress and, from the Xianqing years, troubled by vertigo, left the government to her; in the 1st year of Zongzhang Goguryeo was subdued. He died in the 1st year of Hongdao; Empress Wu took the regency.

emperors.summary: 高宗第七子，武后所生；弘道元年即位，改元嗣圣；欲以韦玄贞为侍中，为武后废为庐陵王，迁房州；圣历元年召还复为太子，为复位张本。
emperors.summary_en: Seventh son of Gaozong by Empress Wu; he took the throne in the 1st year of Hongdao, changing the era to Sisheng; seeking to make Wei Xuanzhen his chamberlain, he was deposed by Wu as Prince of Luling and moved to Fangzhou; in the 1st year of Shengli he was recalled and made heir again — the prelude to his restoration.

emperors.summary: 高宗第八子，武后所生；中宗被废后继位，武后临朝称制；在位期间政事皆决于武后，载初元年武后称帝，改国号周，旦降为皇嗣。
emperors.summary_en: Eighth son of Gaozong by Empress Wu; he succeeded after Zhongzong's deposition, with Wu holding the court; in his reign every matter was decided by Wu, and in the 1st year of Zaichu Wu took the throne, renaming the realm Zhou, and Dan was reduced to heir of the imperial line.

emperors.summary: 从太宗才人到高宗皇后，临朝称制数十年，690年革唐为周正式称帝，是中国史上唯一正统女皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: The only legitimate female emperor in Chinese history, she rose from a consort of Taizong to empress of Gaozong, ruled from behind the screen for decades, and in 690 changed Tang into Zhou and formally took the imperial title.

emperors.summary: 神龙元年张柬之等发动神龙政变，逼武后退位，中宗复位，复国号唐；还都长安后武三思等用事，韦后安乐公主卖官斜封；景龙四年暴崩，韦后临朝。
emperors.summary_en: In the 1st year of Shenlong, Zhang Jianzhi and the others staged the Shenlong coup, forced Empress Wu to abdicate, and restored Zhongzong; the realm's name reverted to Tang. After the return to Chang'an, Wu Sansi and the rest held power, and Empress Wei and the Princess Anle sold offices by "slanted letters"; in the 4th year of Jinglong he died suddenly, and Empress Wei took the regency.

emperors.summary: 中宗第四子；景龙四年中宗暴崩，韦后立之，改元唐隆；同年唐隆政变，李隆基与太平公主诛韦后，重茂让位睿宗；后徙房州，卒。
emperors.summary_en: Fourth son of Zhongzong; when Zhongzong died suddenly in the 4th year of Jinglong, Empress Wei set him up, changing the era to Tanglong; that same year, in the Tanglong coup, Li Longji and the Princess Taiping slew Empress Wei, Chongmao yielded the throne to Ruizong, and was later moved to Fangzhou, where he died.

emperors.summary: 唐隆政变诛韦后，重茂让位，旦复位；立太子隆基；先天元年传位玄宗，自称太上皇；先天二年太平公主赐死，太上皇完全归政；开元四年崩。
emperors.summary_en: After the Tanglong coup slew Empress Wei and Chongmao yielded the throne, Dan was restored; he made his heir Longji; in the 1st year of Xiantian he yielded the throne to Xuanzong and styled himself Grand Emperor; in the 2nd year the Princess Taiping was put to death and the Grand Emperor gave up the government entirely. He died in the 4th year of Kaiyuan.

emperors.summary: 睿宗第三子；唐隆政变诛韦后，先天元年即位，开元元年诛太平公主亲政；开元年间姚崇宋璟为相，史称开元盛世；天宝年间宠杨贵妃、任安禄山，安史之乱起，马嵬赐死贵妃，幸蜀，太上皇归，宝应元年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Ruizong; after the Tanglong coup slew Empress Wei he took the throne in the 1st year of Xiantian, and in the 1st year of Kaiyuan destroyed the Princess Taiping to rule in person; with Yao Chong and Song Jing as chancellors, the Kaiyuan years are called a golden age; in the Tianbao years he doted on Consort Yang and trusted An Lushan until the An–Shi rebellion broke, at Mawei he had the consort put to death, fled to Shu, and returned as Grand Emperor, dying in the 1st year of Baoying.
tags_en: The Rise and Fall of an Age

names.posthumous: 文明武德大圣大宣孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 玄宗第三子；安史乱起，马嵬后北上灵武即位，遥尊玄宗为太上皇；至德二载郭子仪等收复两京；乾元中九节度围安庆绪于邺溃败，史思明再起；宝应元年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Xuanzong; when the An–Shi rebellion broke, after Mawei he went north and took the throne at Lingwu, honoring Xuanzong as Grand Emperor from afar; in the 2nd year of Zhide Guo Ziyi and the others recovered the two capitals; in mid-Qianyuan the nine commissioners besieged An Qingxu at Ye and were routed, and Shi Siming rose again. He died in the 1st year of Baoying.

emperors.summary: 肃宗长子；宝应元年即位，史朝义平，安史之乱大致结束；广德元年吐蕃入长安，帝幸陕；永泰元年仆固怀恩引回纥吐蕃入寇，郭子仪单骑盟回纥；大历十四年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Suzong; on the throne in the 1st year of Baoying, he saw Shi Chaoyi destroyed and the An–Shi rebellion roughly ended; in the 1st year of Guangde the Tibetans entered Chang'an and the emperor fled to Shan; in the 1st year of Yongtai Pugu Huaien drew in the Uyghurs and Tibetans, and Guo Ziyi rode alone to make peace with the Uyghurs. He died in the 14th year of Dali.

emperors.summary: 代宗长子；建中元年杨炎行两税法；建中四年泾原兵变、朱泚据长安称帝，帝幸奉天；兴元元年下罪己诏，李晟收复长安；晚年猜忌聚敛；贞元二十一年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Daizong; in the 1st year of Jianzhong Yang Yan introduced the two-tax system; in the 4th year the Jingyuan mutiny saw Zhu Ci take Chang'an as emperor and the sovereign flee to Fengtian; in the 1st year of Xingyuan the edict of self-blame was issued and Li Sheng recovered Chang'an; in his last years he grew suspicious and grasping. He died in the 21st year of Zhenyuan.
tags_en: The Failed Campaign against the Feudatories

emperors.summary: 德宗长子；贞元二十一年即位，改元永贞；王叔文、王伾等用事，谋夺宦官兵权，史称永贞革新；疾甚，同年禅位太子纯（宪宗），称太上皇，元和元年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Dezong; he took the throne in the 21st year of Zhenyuan, changing the era to Yongzhen; Wang Shuwen and Wang Pi held power and sought to take the eunuchs' armies — the Yongzhen reform; gravely ill, he abdicated that same year to his heir Chun (Xianzong), styled himself Grand Emperor, and died in the 1st year of Yuanhe.
tags_en: The Two Kings and Eight Marshals

emperors.summary: 在位十五年以削藩为主线，平西川、破淮西、威服河朔，成就"元和中兴"而暴崩于宦官疑云的中唐皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: A mid-Tang emperor whose fifteen-year reign centered on reducing the military provinces, pacifying Xichuan, breaking Huaixi, and overawing Heshuo to achieve the Yuanhe Restoration, before dying suddenly amid suspicions involving eunuchs.

emperors.summary: 宪宗第三子；元和十五年宪宗崩（或云为宦官所弑），恒即位，改元长庆；长庆元年河北三镇复叛，元和之功尽失；长庆二年销兵之议，藩镇乘机坐大；游宴怠政，长庆四年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Xianzong; on Xianzong's death in the 15th year of Yuanhe — by the eunuchs' hand, some say — Heng took the throne, changing the era to Changqing; in the 1st year of Changqing the three garrisons of Hebei rose again, and the gains of Yuanhe were lost; in the 2nd year the debate over disbanding the armies let the feudatories grow. He played and feasted, neglecting government, and died in the 4th year of Changqing.

emperors.summary: 穆宗长子；长庆四年即位，改元宝历；好击球手搏、游猎无度，不恤政事；宝历二年夜猎还宫，为宦官苏佐明等所弑，王守澄等立江王涵（文宗）。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Muzong; he took the throne in the 4th year of Changqing, changing the era to Baoli; he loved polo and wrestling, hunting without limit, careless of government; in the 2nd year of Baoli, returning from a night hunt, he was slain by the eunuch Su Zuoming and the others, and Wang Shoucheng set up the Prince of Jiang, Han (Wenzong).

emperors.summary: 穆宗第二子；敬宗被弑后宦官立之；恭俭好文，有意除宦，大和九年甘露之变事败，宦官大杀朝士，帝受制；开成五年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Muzong, set up by the eunuchs after Jingzong's slaying; frugal and fond of letters, he meant to destroy the eunuchs; in the 9th year of Dahe the Ganlu incident failed, the eunuchs slaughtered the courtiers, and the emperor was bound. He died in the 5th year of Kaicheng.
tags_en: The Failed Strike against the Eunuchs

emperors.summary: 穆宗第五子；文宗崩后宦官立之，改元会昌；任李德裕为相，会昌三年讨平泽潞，有会昌中兴之称；会昌五年废佛寺、僧尼还俗，史称会昌法难；好道服丹，会昌六年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Fifth son of Muzong, set up by the eunuchs after Wenzong's death, changing the era to Huichang; with Li Deyu as chancellor he destroyed Zelu in the 3rd year — the "Huichang revival"; in the 5th year he abolished the monasteries and sent the monks and nuns back to lay life — the Huichang persecution; fond of Daoism and elixirs, he died in the 6th year of Huichang.

names.posthumous: 元圣至明成武献文睿智章仁神聪懿道大孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 宪宗第十三子；武宗崩后宦官立之，改元大中；大中元年罢李德裕，牛李党争格局变化；大中中张议潮归义，收复河湟部分；史称大中之治、小太宗；大中十三年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Thirteenth son of Xianzong, set up by the eunuchs after Wuzong's death, changing the era to Dazhong; in the 1st year he dismissed Li Deyu and the Niu–Li factional balance shifted; in mid-Dazhong Zhang Yichao's submission recovered part of the Hehuang; the histories call his reign the Dazhong recovery and him the "Little Taizong." He died in the 13th year of Dazhong.

emperors.summary: 宣宗长子；大中十三年即位，改元咸通；咸通九年桂林戍卒庞勋起义，唐室大震；咸通十四年迎法门寺佛骨，耗费巨万；同年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Xuanzong; he took the throne in the 13th year of Dazhong, changing the era to Xiantong; in the 9th year of Xiantong the Guilin garrison rose under Pang Xun, shaking the Tang house; in the 14th year he welcomed the Famen Temple relic with vast expense, and died that same year.

emperors.summary: 懿宗第五子；十二岁即位，改元乾符；乾符二年王仙芝、黄巢起兵；广明元年黄巢入长安称齐，帝幸蜀；中和三年李克用等破巢，收复长安；文德元年还京后崩。
emperors.summary_en: Fifth son of Yizong; he took the throne at twelve, changing the era to Qianfu; in the 2nd year Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao rose; in the 1st year of Guangming Huang Chao entered Chang'an as emperor of Qi and the sovereign fled to Shu; in the 3rd year of Zhonghe Li Keyong and the others destroyed Chao and recovered Chang'an; returning to the capital, he died in the 1st year of Wende.
tags_en: Prelude to the Fall of Tang

emperors.summary: 懿宗第七子；僖宗崩后即位；有意兴复，屡与藩镇、宦官相争；天复元年宦官劫幸凤翔，依李茂贞；天复三年朱全忠迎帝还京、尽诛宦官；天祐元年全忠逼迁洛阳，旋弑帝。
emperors.summary_en: Seventh son of Yizong, he took the throne after Xizong's death; he meant to restore the realm and struggled again and again with the feudatories and the eunuchs; in the 1st year of Tianfu the eunuchs carried him to Fengxiang to lean on Li Maozhen; in the 3rd year Zhu Quanzhong brought him back and slaughtered the eunuchs; in the 1st year of Tianyou Quanzhong forced the move to Luoyang and soon slew him.

emperors.summary: 昭宗第九子；天祐元年昭宗被弑，朱全忠立之，年十三；天祐二年白马驿之祸，全忠杀朝士三十余人投河；天祐四年禅位于朱全忠，唐亡，梁建；降封后遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Ninth son of Zhaozong; after Zhaozong's slaying in the 1st year of Tianyou, Zhu Quanzhong set him up at thirteen; in the 2nd year came the Baimayi disaster, Quanzhong drowning over thirty courtiers in the river; in the 4th year he abdicated to Quanzhong — Tang perished and Liang arose — and, reduced in rank, was done to death.

emperors.summary: 宋州砀山人，初为黄巢部将，中和二年降唐，赐名全忠，为宣武节度使；天祐元年逼昭宗迁洛阳而弑之；开平元年受禅称帝，国号梁，都开封；乾化二年为子友珪所弑。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Dangshan in Songzhou, at first a general of Huang Chao; he surrendered to Tang in the 2nd year of Zhonghe, was renamed Quanzhong, and made military governor of Xuanwu; in the 1st year of Tianyou he forced Zhaozong to Luoyang and slew him; in the 1st year of Kaiping he received the abdication, founded Liang with its capital at Kaifeng; in the 2nd year of Qianhua he was slain by his son Yougui.

names.display_en: The Last Sovereign of Later Liang

emperors.summary: 太祖第三子；凤历元年诛兄友珪即位；在位与李存勖争河北，梁势渐蹙；龙德三年唐军入汴，末帝命皇甫麟杀己，后梁亡。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Taizu; in the 1st year of Fengli he slew his brother Yougui and took the throne; through his reign he contended with Li Cunxu for Hebei as Liang's strength ebbed; in the 3rd year of Longde the Tang army entered Kaifeng, and the Last Sovereign had Huangfu Lin kill him — Later Liang was no more.

emperors.summary: 沙陀李克用长子；天祐五年嗣晋王，与后梁争雄；同光元年称帝于魏州，国号唐，亲征灭后梁，迁都洛阳；同光三年遣郭崇韬灭前蜀；同光四年兴教门之变，中流矢崩。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of the Shatuo Li Keyong; succeeding as King of Jin in the 5th year of Tianyou, he contended with Later Liang; in the 1st year of Tongguang he took the throne at Weizhou as the realm Tang, campaigned in person and destroyed Later Liang, and moved the capital to Luoyang; in the 3rd year he sent Guo Chongtao to destroy Former Shu; in the 4th year came the Xingjiao Gate mutiny, and he fell to an arrow.

emperors.summary: 代北沙陀，李克用养子，本名邈佶烈；庄宗崩于乱中，嗣源入洛即位；宽政息兵，留心民事，史称五代少有的小康之主；长兴四年崩。
emperors.summary_en: A Shatuo of Daibei, adopted son of Li Keyong, originally named Miaojiilie; with Zhuangzong dead in the chaos, Siyuan entered Luoyang and took the throne; lenient in government and stilling the wars, attentive to the people — the histories call him the one modest peace of the Five Dynasties. He died in the 4th year of Changxing.

emperors.summary: 明宗第三子；长兴四年即位，改元应顺；幼弱不能制藩镇，应顺元年凤翔李从珂起兵，闵帝出奔，被废为鄂王，旋遇害。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Mingzong; he took the throne in the 4th year of Changxing, changing the era to Yingshun; young and weak, unable to control the feudatories, when Li Congke rose at Fengxiang in the 1st year of Yingshun the Min emperor fled, was deposed as Prince of E, and soon done to death.

names.display_en: The Last Sovereign of Later Tang

emperors.summary: 本姓王，明宗养子；清泰元年废闵帝自立；清泰二年猜忌石敬瑭，移镇削兵；清泰三年石敬瑭联契丹反，割燕云十六州；同年契丹晋军入洛，末帝自焚，后唐亡。
emperors.summary_en: Originally of the Wang surname, adopted son of Mingzong; in the 1st year of Qingtai he deposed the Min emperor and took the throne; in the 2nd year he came to distrust Shi Jingtang, moving and stripping his garrisons; in the 3rd year Jingtang rose with the Khitan, ceding the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun; that same year the Khitan and Jin armies entered Luoyang and the Last Sovereign burned himself — Later Tang was no more.

emperors.summary: 沙陀部，明宗之婿，河东节度使；清泰三年称帝于太原，联契丹灭后唐，认契丹主为父，割幽蓟等十六州——史称儿皇帝；天福三年契丹改国号为辽，称臣岁贡格局固定；天福七年崩。
emperors.summary_en: A Shatuo, son-in-law of Mingzong and governor of Hedong; in the 3rd year of Qingtai he took the throne at Taiyuan, destroyed Later Tang with the Khitan, acknowledged the Khitan ruler as father, and ceded the sixteen prefectures of Youji — the "son emperor" of the histories; in the 3rd year of Tianfu the Khitan took the name Liao, and the tribute-and-vassal order was fixed. He died in the 7th year of Tianfu.

names.display_en: The Emperor Chu of Later Jin

emperors.summary: 敬瑭兄子，立为嗣；天福七年即位，改元开运；景延广等主战拒称臣，契丹南伐，晋军一度拒之；开运四年契丹入汴，出帝被俘北迁，后晋亡。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Jingtang's elder brother, made his heir; he took the throne in the 7th year of Tianfu, changing the era to Kaiyun; Jing Yangguang and the others urged war and refused vassalage, the Khitan marched south, and the Jin armies held them for a time; in the 4th year of Kaiyun the Khitan entered Kaifeng, the Emperor Chu was taken north, and Later Jin was no more.

emperors.summary: 沙陀部，仕晋为河东将；契丹入汴灭晋后，知远于太原称帝，国号汉；契丹北还，知远入汴，改元乾祐，杀杜重威等；乾祐元年崩。
emperors.summary_en: A Shatuo, a Hedong general under Jin; after the Khitan took Kaifeng and destroyed Jin, Zhiyuan took the throne at Taiyuan as the realm Han; when the Khitan withdrew north he entered Kaifeng, changed the era to Qianyou, and slew Du Zhongwei and the rest. He died in the 1st year of Qianyou.

names.display_en: The Yin Emperor of Later Han

emperors.summary: 高祖第二子；乾祐元年即位；乾祐二年河中李守贞反，三镇连叛，郭威平之；乾祐三年杀顾命大臣杨邠等，激变；同年郭威起兵入汴，隐帝被杀，后汉亡。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Gaozu; he took the throne in the 1st year of Qianyou; in the 2nd year Li Shouzhen rose at Hezhong, three garrisons in league, and Guo Wei put it down; in the 3rd year he slew the regents Yang Bin and the others, provoking the storm; that same year Guo Wei marched into Kaifeng, the Yin emperor was slain, and Later Han was no more.

emperors.summary: 邢州尧山人；乾祐三年为邺都留守，因隐帝杀大臣起兵入汴；广顺元年称帝，国号周，都开封；废营田、减苛税，为世宗改革铺垫；显德元年崩，养子荣继。
emperors.summary_en: A man of Yaoshan, Xingzhou; in the 3rd year of Qianyou, as garrison commander of Yedu, he marched into Kaifeng over the Yin emperor's slaying of his ministers; in the 1st year of Guangshun he took the throne as the realm Zhou with its capital at Kaifeng; he abolished the military farms and lightened the harsh taxes, preparing Shizong's reforms; he died in the 1st year of Xiande, his adopted son Rong succeeding.

emperors.summary: 在位六年，高平破敌、三征淮南、北伐收复三关，以整军与改革为北宋统一奠基的英年早逝之主。
emperors.summary_en: An emperor who died young after only six years on the throne, breaking the enemy at Gaoping, campaigning thrice in Huainan, and recovering the Three Passes in a northern expedition, whose military reorganization and reforms laid the foundation for Northern Song unification.

emperors.summary: 世宗第四子；显德六年世宗崩，宗训即位，年七岁；显德七年陈桥兵变，赵匡胤黄袍加身，恭帝禅位，周亡宋建；降封郑王，后薨。
emperors.summary_en: Fourth son of Shizong; on Shizong's death in the 6th year of Xiande, Zongxun took the throne at seven; in the 7th year of Xiande came the Chenqiao mutiny — Zhao Kuangyin robed in yellow — and the Gong emperor abdicated: Zhou perished and Song arose. Reduced to Prince of Zheng, he died later.
tags_en: The End of the Five Dynasties

emperors.summary: 陈桥兵变代周建宋，杯酒释兵权以强干弱枝，先南后北平定诸国的开国之君。
emperors.summary_en: The founding emperor who replaced the Zhou and founded the Song through the Chenqiao Mutiny, released his generals' military power over a cup of wine to strengthen the trunk and weaken the branches, and pacified the rival states south first and north later.

names.posthumous: 至仁应道神功圣德文武睿烈大明广孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 烛影斧声继位留疑案，灭北汉、收吴越统一版图，而高梁河之败创下北伐阴影。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding his brother amid the disputed "candle-shade" mystery, he conquered Northern Han and absorbed Wuyue, but the Gaoliang River defeat cast a long shadow over northern campaigns.

names.posthumous: 应符稽古神功让德文明武定章圣元孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 澶渊之盟以岁币换和平，晚年沉溺天书封禅，国势由进取转守成。
emperors.summary_en: The Chanyuan Treaty bought peace with annual tribute, while his later years sank into celestial-letter deification and imperial sacrifices, shifting the realm from expansion to consolidation.

names.posthumous: 体天法道极功全德神文圣武睿哲明孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 仁厚之主，嘉祐之治号为盛世，而庆历新政旋起旋废，积弊未改。
emperors.summary_en: A benevolent ruler whose Jiayou reign is praised as an age of good governance, though the Qingli Reform rose and fell quickly without changing the accumulated ills.

names.posthumous: 体乾应历隆功盛德宪文肃武睿圣宣孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 以宗室入继大统，濮议争礼激荡朝野，在位四年而崩。
emperors.summary_en: Entered the throne from the imperial clan; the Puyi ritual dispute roiled the court, and he died after four years on the throne.

names.posthumous: 绍天法古运德建功英文烈武钦仁圣孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 志在富强，熙宁变法整军理财，元丰改制强干弱枝，然北伐无功、新法争议千年。
emperors.summary_en: Determined to make the state strong, he launched the Xining Reforms to rebuild finances and armies and the Yuanfeng reforms to recentralize power, but the northern campaigns failed and the reforms remain debated to this day.

names.posthumous: 宪元继道显德定功钦文睿武齐圣昭孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 高太后垂帘元祐更化，亲政后绍述熙丰，党争往复为北宋末局伏笔。
emperors.summary_en: Empress Gao's regency enacted the Yuanyou restoration; after he took power he revived the Xining policies, and the factional pendulum set the stage for the Northern Song's end.

names.posthumous: 体神合道骏烈逊功圣文仁德慈宪显孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 一代艺宗，瘦金体冠绝古今，而蔡京当国、花石纲乱政，终致靖康之祸。
emperors.summary_en: An artistic genius whose slender-gold calligraphy crowned the age, he let Cai Jing dominate the court and the Flower-and-Rock Network ravage the land, ending in the Jingkang catastrophe.

emperors.summary: 靖康年间仓皇即位，主战主和反复，终陷二帝北掳之祸，北宋覆亡。
emperors.summary_en: He took the throne in haste during the Jingkang crisis, wavering between war and peace until both emperors were seized and the Northern Song collapsed.

names.posthumous: 受命中兴全功至德圣神武文昭仁宪孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 靖康后于南京即位，建炎播迁、定都临安延宋祚；绍兴和议杀岳飞，为千古讥议。
emperors.summary_en: Ascending at Yingtian after the Jingkang disaster, he weathered the Jianyan flight and fixed the capital at Lin'an to prolong the dynasty, but the Shaoxing Treaty and Yue Fei's execution drew eternal censure.

names.posthumous: 绍统同道冠德昭功哲文神武明圣成孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 南宋最有恢复之志者，隆兴北伐无成而绍熙内禅守成，终功不遂志。
emperors.summary_en: The Southern Song ruler with the strongest ambition to recover the north, his Longxing campaign failed and his later years turned to consolidation; the aim remained unfulfilled.

names.posthumous: 循道宪仁明功茂德温文顺武圣哲慈孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 孝宗内禅继位，与李后猜忌不朝重华宫，绍熙内禅中被废为太上皇。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding by his father's abdication, he fell out with his wife, stopped attending the court of the retired emperor, and was deposed as retired emperor in the Shaoxi abdication.

names.posthumous: 法天备道纯德茂功仁文哲武圣睿恭孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 绍熙内禅中即位，权归韩侂胄、史弥远，庆元党禁、开禧北伐、嘉定和议迭见。
emperors.summary_en: Placed on the throne by the Shaoxi abdication, he left power to Han Tuozhou and Shi Miyuan through the Qingyuan proscription, the Kaixi campaign, and the Jiading treaty.

names.posthumous: 建道备德大功复兴烈文仁武圣明安孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 端平入洛联蒙灭金而反噬随来，理学官学化达于极，晚任贾似道为亡国伏线。
emperors.summary_en: The Duanping recovery and the Mongol alliance that destroyed Jin soon backfired; Neo-Confucianism reached its official peak, and his late reliance on Jia Sidao planted the seeds of ruin.

emperors.summary: 理宗养子入继，荒于酒色政在贾似道，襄樊陷而门户洞开。
emperors.summary_en: Adopted by Lizong, he indulged in wine and women while Jia Sidao governed; Xiangyang fell and the gateway was flung open.

emperors.summary: 年四岁即位，德祐二年临安降元，北狩封瀛国公，南宋正统遂移二王。
emperors.summary_en: Ascending at age four, he surrendered Lin'an to the Mongols in 1276 and was taken north as Duke of Ying; the Song cause passed to the two princes.

emperors.summary: 临安降后二王南奔，福州即位图再兴，流亡海上两年崩于硇洲。
emperors.summary_en: After Lin'an fell he fled south, was enthroned at Fuzhou to revive the cause, drifted at sea for two years, and died at Naozhou.

emperors.summary: 崖山之战宋军覆灭，陆秀夫负帝蹈海，宋三百二十年社稷终。
emperors.summary_en: At the battle of Yashan the Song fleet was destroyed and Lu Xiufu carried the child emperor into the sea, ending the dynasty of 320 years.

emperors.summary: 以契丹迭剌部起家，即可汗位、建元称帝，创契丹大字，定南北面官制，灭渤海而建辽基业。
emperors.summary_en: Rising from the Diela tribe, he took the khagan throne, founded the Liao with era names, created the Khitan script, established the dual-administration system, and destroyed Balhae to build the Liao foundation.

emperors.summary: 扶立石敬瑭得燕云十六州，灭后晋入主中原，然以「打草谷」失民心，北返途中崩于栾城。
emperors.summary_en: He enthroned Shi Jingtang in return for the Sixteen Prefectures, destroyed Later Jin and entered the Central Plains, but alienated the people with plundering; he died at Luancheng on the way back north.

emperors.summary: 太祖长孙，太宗崩后继立，天禄年间南伐后汉，被察割所弑，在位五年。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest grandson of Taizu, he succeeded after Taizong's death, campaigned south against Later Han during the Tianlu years, and was assassinated by Chage in 951 after five years on the throne.

emperors.summary: 世宗遇弑后即位，嗜酒酣睡不理朝政，政多废弛，终为近侍所弑。
