emperors.summary_en: Succeeding after Shizong's assassination, he drank and slept away his reign, letting government decay until his servants killed him.

emperors.summary: 穆宗被弑后继位，萧绰为后预政，乾亨元年高梁河大破宋军，辽势复振。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding after Muzong's murder, he let Empress Xiao Chuo share power; in 979 the Liao routed the Song at the Gaoliang River and restored its strength.

emperors.summary: 萧太后摄政下澶渊订盟，辽宋百年和平；亲政后继续汉化，为辽代极盛之君。
emperors.summary_en: Under Empress Dowager Xiao's regency he signed the Chanyuan Treaty, bringing a century of peace with Song; ruling in person afterward, he deepened Sinicization and led Liao to its zenith.

emperors.summary: 重熙年间曾向宋索关南之地，亲征西夏未竟，好文艺而政事平。
emperors.summary_en: During the Chongxi years he pressed Song for the Guannan lands and campaigned against Western Xia without decision; he favored arts and letters, keeping a flat government.

emperors.summary: 在位四十六年，乙辛之祸废后杀子，崇佛好儒而政事渐坏，辽之衰自此始。
emperors.summary_en: Forty-six years on the throne, he let Yixin's conspiracy depose his empress and kill his son; he revered Buddhism and Confucianism while government decayed - the beginning of Liao's decline.

emperors.summary: 道宗之孙，享国之末而纵情畋猎，阿骨打起兵后辽兵连败，保大五年被俘，辽亡。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of Daozong and the last Liao ruler, he indulged in hunting while Aguda rose; after successive defeats he was captured in 1125 and Liao fell.

names.posthumous: 应乾兴运昭德定功仁明庄孝大圣武元皇帝

emperors.summary: 以女真完颜部起兵反辽，宁江州、出河店大捷，收国元年称帝建国，灭辽之势自此定。
emperors.summary_en: Raising the Wanyan clan of the Jurchen against Liao, he won great victories at Ningjiangzhou and Chuhedian, founded the Jin in 1115, and sealed Liao's doom.

names.posthumous: 体元应运世德昭功哲惠仁圣文烈皇帝

emperors.summary: 兄终弟及继位，遣将灭辽灭北宋，两京并下，金之国势极于此时。
emperors.summary_en: Succeeding his brother, he sent generals to destroy Liao and Northern Song, taking both capitals and pushing Jin to its greatest extent.

names.posthumous: 弘基缵武庄靖孝成皇帝

emperors.summary: 太祖嫡长孙，天眷改制颁汉官制，皇统元年与宋绍兴和议；晚年诛戮无度，为海陵所弑。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest grandson of Taizu, he issued the Chinese-style official system in the Tianjuan reforms and made the Shaoxing Treaty with Song; his later years of indiscriminate killing ended in assassination by Hailing.

emperors.summary: 弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京、欲混一天下而大举南伐，采石之败后为部将所弑。
emperors.summary_en: He killed Xizong and took the throne, moved the capital to Yanjing, and launched a colossal southern campaign to unify the realm; after the Caishi defeat his own generals killed him.

names.posthumous: 光天兴运文德武功圣明仁孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 辽阳即位代海陵，与宋隆兴和议改叔侄；大定之治号称小尧舜，金之全盛。
emperors.summary_en: Taking the throne at Liaoyang in Hailing's place, he renegotiated the Song treaty to uncle-nephew rank; his Dading governance earned him the title of "Little Yao and Shun" - the zenith of Jin.

names.posthumous: 宪天光运仁文义武神圣英孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 世宗之孙，修礼乐、定官制、崇文教，泰和对宋之战亦胜；然奢靡渐起，金势转衰之始。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of Shizong, he codified rites and music, fixed the bureaucracy, and honored letters, and won the Taihe war with Song; yet extravagance crept in as Jin began to decline.

emperors.summary: 章宗之叔入继，蒙古南侵、野狐岭大败，中都告急；至宁元年为纥石烈执中所弑。
emperors.summary_en: Uncle of Zhangzong raised to the throne, he faced the Mongol invasion, the catastrophe at Yehuling, and the siege of Zhongdu, and was killed by Heshilie Zhizhong in 1213.

names.posthumous: 继天兴统述道勤仁英武圣孝皇帝

emperors.summary: 卫绍王被弑后即位，弃中都迁汴，三面受敌而南伐取偿于宋，金势愈蹙。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned after Weishao's murder, he abandoned Zhongdu for Bian, fought enemies on three sides, and sought compensation by raiding Song to the south - squeezing Jin ever tighter.

emperors.summary: 末代之主，励精图治而蒙古势不可当，汴京失守后奔蔡州，天兴三年城破自缢，金亡。
emperors.summary_en: The last Jin emperor, diligent but facing the Mongol tide, he fled Bianjing for Caizhou and hanged himself in 1234 as the city fell - the end of Jin.

emperors.summary: 统一蒙古诸部，建立大蒙古国；西征花剌子模，临终前灭西夏，开创横跨欧亚的帝国。
emperors.summary_en: He united the Mongol tribes, founded the Mongol Empire, campaigned west against Khwarazm, and destroyed Western Xia on his deathbed, opening a realm spanning Eurasia.

emperors.summary: 太祖第三子，1229年即汗位；联宋灭金，重用耶律楚材行汉法，遣拔都西征，帝国达于极盛。
emperors.summary_en: Third son of Genghis Khan, he took the throne in 1229, destroyed Jin with Song help, employed Yelü Chucai for Chinese governance, and sent Batu west, bringing the empire to its height.

emperors.summary: 太宗长子，乃马真后摄政四年后即位；在位仅两年，汗位再虚，帝国中枢渐有裂痕。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Ogedei, he took the throne after Toregene's four-year regency and reigned only two years, leaving the succession vacant again and the empire's center cracking.

emperors.summary: 拖雷长子，忽里台拥立；遣旭烈兀西征、亲征大理灭之，又亲攻宋，崩于合州钓鱼城下。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Tolui, raised by the kurultai, he sent Hulegu west, conquered Dali in person, then campaigned against Song and died before Diaoyucheng at Hezhou.

names.display_en: Kublai Khan, Emperor Shizu of Yuan

emperors.summary: 灭宋完成大一统，建国号大元、定都大都，以行省与站赤制度塑造后世格局的征服王朝皇帝。
emperors.summary_en: A conquest-dynasty emperor who destroyed the Song to complete a grand unification, proclaimed the dynastic name Great Yuan, fixed the capital at Dadu, and shaped later ages through the provincial and postal-relay systems.

emperors.summary: 世祖之孙，守成之君；与海都、笃哇之乱定，国内承平，而滥赐宗戚、财用渐绌。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of Khubilai and a consolidator, he ended the Qaidu-Duwa wars and kept the peace, though lavish grants to the clans drained the treasury.

emperors.summary: 成宗之侄，总兵北边拥兵入京即位；滥封滥赏、币制紊乱，仁宗后行兄终弟及之约。
emperors.summary_en: Nephew of Chengzong raised by the northern army, he distributed titles and bounty without measure and unsettled the currency, agreeing with his brother on brother-to-brother succession.

names.personal: 孛儿只斤爱育黎拔力八达

emperors.summary: 武宗之弟，践兄终弟及之约即位；复科举、译经史，号称贤主，然背约传子，为后来内乱伏线。
emperors.summary_en: Younger brother of Wuzong enthroned by the succession pact, he restored the examinations and patronized learning, yet broke the pact by passing the throne to his son, seeding later turmoil.

emperors.summary: 仁宗之子，背约即位；用拜住行新政、减冗费，为「南坡之变」所弑，新政遂止。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Renzong who succeeded against the pact, he employed Baiju to reform and cut waste until the Nanpo coup killed him and ended the reforms.

emperors.summary: 晋王也孙铁木儿，英宗被弑后继立；在位守成，然用人宽纵，为两都之变伏根。
emperors.summary_en: Prince Jin Yesun Temur, raised after Yingzong's murder, ruled as a consolidator but with loose discipline, planting the roots of the Two-Capital conflict.

emperors.summary: 泰定帝之子，上都即位一月而两都之战败，下落不明；元史未立本纪，图鉴以准帝收录。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Taiding, he reigned one month at Shangdu before losing the Two-Capital War and vanishing; no biography in the Yuan History, here included as a quasi-emperor.

emperors.summary: 武宗次子，两都之战后大都即位；曾让位兄明宗，明宗暴崩而复立；建奎章阁兴文教，而明宗暴崩之谜为千古疑案。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Wuzong, he took the throne at Dadu after the Two-Capital War, briefly yielded it to his elder brother Mingzong, and resumed it after Mingzong's sudden death; he founded the Kui-zhang Pavilion for letters, yet his brother's death remains an eternal mystery.

emperors.summary: 武宗长子，流亡西域，文宗让位后即位于和林道中；半年后暴崩，史多疑为燕铁木儿所毒。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Wuzong, exiled to the west, he was enthroned on the road to Karakorum when Wenzong yielded; he died suddenly half a year later, widely suspected poisoned by El Temür.

emperors.summary: 明宗次子，文宗崩后为燕铁木儿所立，在位四十余日而崩，未及改元。
emperors.summary_en: Second son of Mingzong, raised by El Temur after Wenzong's death, he reigned little more than a month before dying without an era of his own.

emperors.summary: 明宗长子，宁宗崩后即位；至正新政一度有为，红巾之乱起后天下鼎沸，至正二十八年弃大都北奔，元亡。
emperors.summary_en: Eldest son of Mingzong, enthroned after Ningzong, he briefly reformed in the Zhizheng era, then lost the realm to the Red Turban revolt and fled Dadu in 1368, ending the Yuan in China.

emperors.summary: 以布衣起兵，驱元复汉，定鼎南京；废丞相、严刑峻法，洪武之治奠定有明一代制度。
emperors.summary_en: Rising from peasant origins, he drove out the Yuan and fixed the capital at Nanjing; abolishing the chancellorship and ruling with stern law, he laid the Ming institutions.

emperors.summary: 太祖之孙，锐意削藩，激成靖难之变；南京陷后下落不明，史称「建文逊国」。
emperors.summary_en: Grandson of Taizu, he pressed the reduction of the feudal princes, provoking the Jingnan campaign; after Nanjing fell he vanished - the 'Jianwen abdication' mystery.

emperors.summary: 以靖难夺位，五征漠北、迁都北京、遣郑和下西洋，永乐之世号为全盛，然夺位之疑终身不释。
emperors.summary_en: He took the throne by the Jingnan war, campaigned five times into the steppe, moved the capital to Beijing, and sent Zheng He across the seas; the Yongle age was one of grandeur, though his seizure of the throne shadowed his life.

emperors.summary: 成祖之子，即位即宽仁减役、赦建文旧臣；在位十月而崩，然「仁宣之治」由其奠基。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Chengzu, he opened his reign with lenient policies and pardons for the Jianwen loyalists; he died after ten months, yet his benevolence underlay the Ren-Xuan peace.

emperors.summary: 仁宗之子，平汉王高煦之乱，弃交趾罢远略；三杨辅政，仁宣之治臻于极盛。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Renzong, he crushed the Prince of Han's revolt, gave up Jiaozhi, and governed with the Three Yangs; the Ren-Xuan peace reached its zenith.

emperors.summary: 九岁即位，宠信宦官王振；亲征瓦剌，土木之变被俘，北狩一年而还，被尊太上皇。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at nine, he trusted the eunuch Wang Zhen, led a personal campaign against the Oirats, was captured at Tumu, spent a year in captivity, and returned as retired emperor.

emperors.summary: 土木之变后监国即位，任于谦守北京退瓦剌；迎还英宗而废其子，夺门之变后被废，崩于西内。
emperors.summary_en: After the Tumu disaster he took the throne, entrusted Yu Qian with the defense of Beijing, welcomed Yingzong back only to depose his son, and was himself deposed in the Restoration coup, dying in the western palace.

emperors.summary: 夺门复位，杀于谦为终身之憾；晚年罢宫妃殉葬，遗诏免殉，为仁政之善终。
emperors.summary_en: Restored by the coup, he executed Yu Qian to his lifelong regret, yet in his last years abolished the concubine burials - a benevolent end.

emperors.summary: 英宗之子，即位昭雪于谦；设西厂、宠万贵妃、行传奉官，成化之政渐坏。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Yingzong, he rehabilitated Yu Qian on accession, but set up the Western Depot, doted on Consort Wan, and sold offices through the 'transmitted appointments' - governance decayed.

emperors.summary: 宪宗之子，唯一一夫一妻之帝；任贤纳谏、罢传奉官，弘治之治为明中叶仅见之清明。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Xianzong and the only Ming emperor with one wife, he employed the worthy, heeded remonstrance, and cleared the offices; the Hongzhi era was the cleanest of the middle Ming.

emperors.summary: 孝宗独子，好佚乐、宠八虎；自封总督军务，应州之战亲临阵前，又亲征宁王之乱。
emperors.summary_en: The only son of Xiaozong, pleasure-loving and fond of the 'Eight Tigers,' he styled himself commander-in-chief, faced battle in person at Yingzhou, and led a personal campaign against the Prince of Ning.

emperors.summary: 武宗堂弟入继大统，大礼议定其名分；嘉靖初年一度振作，后崇道斋醮、严嵩当国，庚戌之变京师被掠。
emperors.summary_en: Cousin of Wuzong who entered the line of succession, he settled his title in the Great Ritual Controversy, showed early vigor, then turned to Daoist rites while Yan Song ruled and the Mongols sacked the capital's outskirts in 1550.

emperors.summary: 世宗之子，用徐阶、高拱、张居正；俺答封贡，隆庆开关，北边晏然。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Shizong, he employed Xu Jie, Gao Gong, and Zhang Juzheng; Altan Khan was enfeoffed, the ports reopened, and the northern border rested.

emperors.summary: 穆宗之子，张居正辅政行万历新政；居正卒后怠政，矿税之祸、党争之炽，萨尔浒之败为明亡之兆。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Muzong, he enacted the Wanli reforms under Zhang Juzheng, then after Juzheng's death lapsed into neglect - the mining-tax abuses, factional warfare, and the Sarhu defeat all foretold the fall.

emperors.summary: 神宗之子，国本之争中艰难为储；即位发帑罢矿税，一月而崩于红丸案，为明宫疑案之首。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Shenzong, made heir after the long succession struggle, he distributed the treasury and repealed the mining taxes on accession - and died within a month in the Red Pill case, first of the Ming palace mysteries.

emperors.summary: 光宗之子，好木工而政归魏忠贤；东林党祸、阉党横暴，宁远之捷差强人意。
emperors.summary_en: Son of Guangzong, fond of carpentry while Wei Zhongxian ruled; the Donglin massacre and eunuch tyranny marked his reign, brightened only by the Ningyuan victory.

emperors.summary: 末代之主，勤政十七年而回天无术；杀袁崇焕自毁长城，甲申之变李自成入京，煤山自缢，明亡。
emperors.summary_en: The last Ming emperor, diligent for seventeen years in a lost cause; he executed Yuan Chonghuan and broke his own shield; in 1644 Li Zicheng took Beijing and he hanged himself on Coal Hill.

emperors.summary: 以十三副遗甲起兵，统一女真诸部，创八旗制度，1616 年建后金称汗；萨尔浒大破明军，宁远之败负伤而崩。
emperors.summary_en: Rising with thirteen suits of armor, he united the Jurchen tribes, created the Eight Banners, and founded the Later Jin in 1616; he crushed the Ming at Sarhu and died of wounds after Ningyuan.

emperors.summary: 改国号后金为清、改汗称帝；亲征朝鲜、两入塞内，为入关定鼎奠基。
emperors.summary_en: He renamed the Later Jin to Qing and took the imperial title, campaigned in person against Joseon, and twice broke through the passes, preparing the conquest.

emperors.summary: 六岁即位，多尔衮摄政下入关定鼎北京；亲政后定鼎中原之局成，二十四岁而崩。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at six, he entered the passes under Dorgon's regency and fixed the capital at Beijing; ruling in person, he consolidated the conquest and died at twenty-four.

emperors.summary: 八岁即位，擒鳌拜、平三藩、收台湾、定喀尔喀，亲征噶尔丹；康熙之治号为千古一帝。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at eight, he seized Oboi, crushed the Three Feudatories, took Taiwan, settled the Khalkha, and campaigned in person against Galdan - the Kangxi reign, "the greatest emperor."

emperors.summary: 以亲王入继，设军机处、行摊丁入亩、密建储位；严猛之政为康乾之世承上启下。
emperors.summary_en: Entering from princely rank, he founded the Grand Council, instituted the single-tax and the secret succession, and ruled with stern rigor, bridging Kangxi and Qianlong.

emperors.summary: 十全武功拓土万里，四库全书集千古文；盛世之下，吏治渐弛、鸦片之芽已萌。
emperors.summary_en: His "Ten Complete Campaigns" extended the empire; the Four Treasuries gathered all letters; yet beneath the splendor, officialdom rotted and the opium seed was sown.

emperors.summary: 受内禅即位，太上皇训政三年；亲政后诛和珅，然白莲教之乱耗财，盛世之衰已成。
emperors.summary_en: He ascended by abdication under three years of the retired emperor's tutelage; ruling in person, he executed Heshen, but the White Lotus war drained the treasury and the decline was plain.

emperors.summary: 虎门销烟而鸦片战争败，江宁条约开五口通商，道光之世为近代变局之始。
emperors.summary_en: The opium burned at Humen, the Opium War lost, the Treaty of Nanjing opening five ports - the Daoguang reign began the modern transformation.

emperors.summary: 太平天国起于广西，英法联军入京，文宗北狩热河，病崩于行在。
emperors.summary_en: The Taiping rose in Guangxi, the Anglo-French took Beijing, and the emperor fled to Rehe, dying there.

emperors.summary: 六岁即位，两宫垂帘；曾国藩等克天京平太平天国，洋务运动初兴，而亲政未及二年而崩。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at six under the two empresses dowager, he saw Nanjing retaken and the Taiping crushed by Zeng Guofan, and the Self-Strengthening begun - then died within two years of taking power.

emperors.summary: 四岁即位，慈禧太后垂帘；戊戌变法百日而废，庚子之变两宫西狩，光绪三十四年崩。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at four under Empress Dowager Cixi, he saw the Hundred Days Reform fail in 1898 and the flight west after the Boxer crisis, and died in 1908.

emperors.summary: 三岁即位，辛亥鼎革后逊位，帝制终结；其后经历复辟、伪满，1967 年卒于北京。
emperors.summary_en: Enthroned at three, he abdicated after the 1911 Revolution, ending the imperial system; his later life touched the restoration and Manchukuo, and he died in Beijing in 1967.
